The Honda Gold Wing Tour has long been the gold standard in touring motorcycles, and the 2026 model is no exception. Let's delve into what makes the 2026 Honda Gold Wing Tour a remarkable machine:
Engine and Performance:
Legendary Six-Cylinder Engine: The heart of the Gold Wing Tour is its smooth and powerful 1,833cc liquid-cooled, horizontally opposed six-cylinder engine. This engine delivers effortless power and torque, making long journeys a breeze.
7-Speed DCT: The Gold Wing Tour comes standard with Honda's advanced 7-speed Dual Clutch Transmission (DCT). This transmission offers seamless gear changes, whether you're cruising on the open road or navigating city streets. It also features a "creep" mode for low-speed maneuvering and a reverse assist for easy parking.
Throttle-by-Wire: The throttle-by-wire system provides precise control and enhances the overall riding experience. It also enables features like cruise control and selectable riding modes.
Comfort and Features:
Luxurious Comfort: The Gold Wing Tour is designed for ultimate comfort, with a plush seat, ample legroom, and excellent wind protection. The fairing and windscreen provide a quiet and comfortable cockpit, even at high speeds.
Advanced Suspension: The double-wishbone front suspension and Pro-Link rear suspension provide a smooth and controlled ride, even over rough roads. The electronically adjustable suspension allows you to fine-tune the ride to your preferences and riding conditions.
Spacious Storage: The Gold Wing Tour offers plenty of storage space for your gear, with a large trunk and saddlebags. You can easily pack everything you need for a long trip.
Modern Technology: The Gold Wing Tour is packed with modern technology, including a 7-inch TFT display, Bluetooth connectivity, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration, and a premium sound system.
Heated Grips and Seat: For added comfort in cooler weather, the Gold Wing Tour is equipped with heated grips and a heated seat.
50th Anniversary Edition:
Special Badging: The 50th Anniversary Edition of the Gold Wing Tour features special badging and graphics to commemorate this milestone.
Exclusive Colors: The anniversary edition is available in unique colors that set it apart from the standard model.

Engine & Performance Upgrades
The all-new Bajaj Pulsar 150 2026 receives its most comprehensive overhaul yet while retaining its recognizable silhouette. At its heart is an updated 149.5cc air/oil-cooled single-cylinder engine that produces 14 PS of power and an increased peak torque of 14.1 Nm. Notably, peak power is delivered at an earlier 8,000 rpm, providing stronger low- and mid-range acceleration for city commuting. Power is sent to the rear wheel through an upgraded 5-speed transmission designed for smoother and more usable gear changes. The setup is further refined by a new single-cradle frame that uses the engine as a stressed member, replacing the traditional double-cradle chassis to provide improved stability and sharper handling.
Tech Features & Hardware Overhaul
Bajaj has modernized the chassis and electronic features across the 2026 range. The iconic twin rear shocks have been replaced by a modern monoshock suspension setup, working alongside standard 33mm right-side-up telescopic front forks. Higher variants feature an advanced 5-inch TFT instrument cluster with Bluetooth connectivity, turn-by-turn navigation through Google Maps mirroring, and incoming call and SMS alerts. Other notable additions include an Integrated Starter Generator (ISG) for quieter starts, a crawl mode for easier movement through bumper-to-bumper traffic, and full-LED lighting for both the headlamp and tail section.
Variants & Braking Configurations
The 2026 lineup is offered in three primary configurations, each aimed at different budgets and feature requirements:
SD Single Seat (Base Variant): Features a single-piece seat, a 260mm front disc brake with single-channel ABS, a 130mm rear drum brake, and a reverse LCD digital display.
TD Single Seat (Mid Variant): Upgrades to dual disc brakes, with a 260mm front disc and 230mm rear disc, along with single-channel ABS. It also adds the standard ISG with crawl mode and a 5-inch TFT console.
TD Split Seat (Top Variant): Shares the dual-disc setup, ISG, crawl mode, and 5-inch TFT display with the mid-spec model but adds a sportier split-seat design and revised pillion ergonomics.

Its muscular design language, reminiscent of its bigger siblings, the NS160 and NS200, makes it visually appealing. The bike is powered by a 124.45cc, single-cylinder, air-cooled engine that delivers a healthy dose of power and torque, making it suitable for city commutes and occasional highway rides.
The NS125 is equipped with features like a fully digital instrument cluster, LED headlamps, and a comfortable riding position, adding to its appeal. While it may not be as powerful as some competitors, the NS125 compensates with its fuel efficiency and low maintenance costs, making it a practical choice for daily use. However, some riders may find the suspension a bit stiff on rough roads, and the lack of a rear disc brake could be a concern for safety-conscious riders.

Description:
The all-new Bajaj Pulsar 125 2026 gives the popular 125cc commuter motorcycle a more modern and sporty character while retaining the practicality that has made the Pulsar name popular among everyday riders. The updated motorcycle carries the brand’s familiar design language, featuring a muscular fuel tank, sharp body panels, sporty graphics, and a compact tail section that give it a more substantial presence than a typical commuter bike.
The lighting and instrument setup add a contemporary touch, while the overall design remains practical for everyday use. Its relatively compact dimensions and manageable riding position also make it well suited to busy city streets and regular commuting.
At the heart of the Pulsar 125 is a refined 125cc single-cylinder engine, engineered to deliver a useful balance of responsive acceleration, smooth power delivery, and fuel efficiency. The engine is paired with a conventional gearbox that is easy to operate in stop-and-go traffic while providing enough flexibility for longer rides and open-road travel. The predictable power delivery also makes the bike approachable for newer riders who want a motorcycle that is easy to control.
The Pulsar 125 2026 also places a strong emphasis on rider comfort. It features an upright riding position, a well-padded seat, and practical ergonomics designed for extended daily use. Its suspension is tuned to absorb common urban road imperfections, helping provide a comfortable ride over uneven streets. The braking system is designed to offer controlled and predictable stopping performance in everyday riding conditions.
Overall, the new Bajaj Pulsar 125 combines the economical running costs and everyday practicality of a commuter motorcycle with the sharper styling and more engaging character associated with the Pulsar family. It is an appealing option for riders looking for an affordable 125cc motorcycle that offers useful performance, comfortable ergonomics, and a sportier appearance without becoming impractical for daily commuting.

Description: The newly launched TVS Apache RTX 300 2026 marks TVS Motor Company's entry into the competitive 300cc adventure touring segment. Built on an all-new platform, this adventure motorcycle is powered by a new 299cc, liquid-cooled, single-cylinder 'RT-XD4' engine, delivering an impressive 35.5 bhp and 28.5 Nm of peak torque, paired with a six-speed gearbox that includes a bi-directional quick-shifter. Designed with a tall stance and a purposeful semi-fairing, the bike features USD front forks, a rear monoshock, and rides on 19-inch front and 17-inch rear wheels fitted with dual-purpose tyres. Its feature set is extensive, boasting a full-color TFT instrument cluster with smartphone connectivity and Map Mirroring, a ride-by-wire throttle, multiple Ride Modes (Tour, Rally, Urban, Rain), Traction Control, and switchable dual-channel ABS, making it a technologically advanced and versatile option for both highway touring and light off-roading.

The newly released 2027 BMW F 450 GS firmly positions itself in the mid-size adventure segment, offering a lightweight and agile alternative to today's larger, high-displacement ADV motorcycles. Drawing clear design inspiration from its flagship sibling, the BMW R 1300 GS, it features the signature X-shaped LED headlight and the iconic GS silhouette. Beneath the bodywork is an all-new, liquid-cooled 420cc parallel-twin engine that produces a class-competitive 48 horsepower and 32 lb-ft of torque. BMW has paired this new powerplant with a 135-degree crankshaft offset to deliver a smooth, characterful ride with a throaty exhaust note while keeping the wet weight to a remarkably light 393 pounds.
On the technology front, the bike introduces the Easy Ride Clutch (ERC), an advanced centrifugal clutch system that allows riders to stop and start without using the clutch lever, making low-speed technical off-road riding and stop-and-go city traffic significantly easier. Complementing its impressive performance, the F 450 GS comes equipped with a premium 6.5-inch TFT display, lean-sensitive ABS Pro, and robust KYB suspension offering 7.1 inches of travel. Altogether, the new BMW F 450 GS proves that you do not need a massive 1200cc adventure bike to confidently tackle challenging backcountry trails.

Description:
Introduction
The 2026 Bajaj Pulsar RS200 isn't just a motorcycle; it's a statement. A testament to Bajaj's commitment to performance and style, the RS200 has been a favorite among riders for years. With the latest iteration, Bajaj has taken this iconic machine to new heights.
A Design That Commands Attention
The RS200's sharp, angular design is instantly recognizable. Its fully-faired bodywork, twin projector headlamps, and LED DRLs give it an aggressive, sporty stance. The new 2026 model retains this iconic look while introducing subtle refinements, such as a redesigned tail section and updated graphics. The result is a motorcycle that's as visually striking as it is powerful.
Engineered for Thrills
At the heart of the RS200 lies a potent 199.5cc, liquid-cooled, single-cylinder engine. This powerplant delivers a thrilling 24.5 PS of power and 18.7 Nm of torque, ensuring effortless acceleration and exhilarating top speeds. The engine is mated to a smooth 6-speed gearbox, providing precise shifts and optimal power delivery across the rev range.
Features That Elevate the Ride
The 2026 RS200 comes packed with features that enhance both performance and convenience. A new LCD instrument console provides essential information at a glance, while dual-channel ABS with multiple modes ensures confident braking in various conditions. The addition of a wider rear tire not only improves stability but also enhances the bike's sporty character.
A Comfortable Ride, Despite the Sporty Stance
While the RS200 is designed for spirited riding, Bajaj hasn't compromised on comfort. The ergonomics are well-balanced, allowing for relaxed cruising and aggressive riding positions. The suspension setup, consisting of telescopic forks at the front and a monoshock at the rear, effectively absorbs road imperfections, ensuring a comfortable ride even on rough surfaces.

Braking and Suspension: The scooter is equipped with a front disc brake and a rear drum brake, providing reliable stopping power. It uses telescopic front forks and dual rear shock absorbers for a comfortable ride.
Competitors: The Hero Xoom 160 competes with models like the Yamaha Aerox 155 and Aprilia SXR 160 in the maxi-scooter segment.
specs: Liquid cooled, 4 Valve single cylinder SOHC

Description:
The Yadea Fierider 2026 is a sleek and powerful electric scooter designed for modern urban commuting. Its design draws inspiration from sports cars, featuring iconic shapes and sculpted surfaces that give it a dynamic appearance.
At the heart of the Fierider is an 11 kW side-mounted integrated motor that delivers a peak torque of 238 Nm. This setup allows the scooter to accelerate from 0 to 50 km/h in just 2.5 seconds, reaching a top speed of 100 km/h. The motor's efficiency enables the Fierider to handle inclines of over 25 degrees with ease.
The scooter is powered by a dual lithium battery pack, each with a capacity of 72V 27Ah, providing a combined capacity that ensures a maximum range of up to 140 km on a single charge. These removable batteries are designed to function effectively in temperatures ranging from -20°C to 65°C and come with an IPX7 waterproof rating, ensuring reliability in various weather conditions.
Safety is a priority for the Fierider, which is equipped with an Anti-lock Braking System (ABS) to prevent wheel lock-up during sudden braking. The scooter also features adjustable hydraulic shock absorbers for a smooth ride and 14-inch semi-hot melt radial tires that provide excellent grip, especially during high-speed cornering.
For rider convenience, the Fierider offers a 7-inch VA dashboard that displays essential information clearly. The scooter includes 31 liters of under-seat storage space, accommodating a helmet and other personal items. The Class D LED lighting system ensures enhanced visibility with a headlamp brightness of 50,000 cd and a visibility distance of up to 70 meters, improving safety during night rides.
specs: F: 14 inches R: 13 inches Aluminum Wheel

Description:
The Yadea VoltGuard 2026 is a modern electric scooter designed for city travel. It has a strong 5-kilowatt (kW) mid-drive motor that lets it reach speeds up to 80 kilometers per hour (km/h). This motor uses special technology to make rides smooth and quick, so you don't feel any weak starts or sudden jerks.
The scooter comes with two 72-volt, 27-ampere-hour (Ah) ATL lithium batteries. These batteries store a lot of energy without adding extra weight. They also have a smart system that charges them while you ride, which means you can travel up to 151 kilometers on a single charge, as tested under WMTC conditions at a maximum speed of 50 km/h.
For a comfortable ride, the VoltGuard 2026 has front and rear hydraulic shock absorbers that help smooth out bumps in the road. It also features a combination braking system (CBS) that makes stopping safe and quick. The scooter has a 16-inch front tire and a 14-inch rear tire, which help you navigate through busy city streets easily.
The seat is 700 millimeters long, providing enough space for you and a passenger, and the scooter can carry up to 150 kilograms. There's also plenty of storage: a 20-liter compartment under the seat and a 287-millimeter space on the floorboard for your belongings.
In terms of technology, the VoltGuard 2026 includes features like multiple unlock options, NFC capabilities, and a reverse mode. These additions make it a convenient choice for daily commuting.

The Yadea Orla 2026 is an electric scooter that blends classic European design with modern technology. Its elegant appearance is complemented by a V-shaped LED headlight, providing brightness of 20,000 candelas to ensure clear visibility at night.
Powered by an 800-watt high-efficiency motor, the Orla can reach speeds up to 48 kilometers per hour, making it suitable for daily commutes and short trips. The motor operates at 88% efficiency, offering strong performance while conserving energy.
The scooter features a TTFAR graphene battery with a capacity of 60V 26Ah, extending its lifespan to three times that of standard batteries. A full charge allows the Orla to travel up to 80 kilometers, providing ample range for urban travel.
Designed to handle various weather conditions, the Orla has waterproof connectors and rust-resistant parts, achieving an IPX7 waterproof rating. It can operate in water up to 300 millimeters deep, ensuring reliability during rainy seasons.
The scooter's completely enclosed chassis, along with front and rear fenders, protects internal components from water and debris. Additionally, the energy-retrieving system converts kinetic energy into electrical energy during braking, enhancing overall efficiency.
For rider comfort, the Orla is designed with ergonomics in mind, featuring a spacious 17-liter under-seat storage compartment that can accommodate a full-face helmet. It also includes a USB charging port for mobile devices, a 5-kilogram capacity luggage hook, and front and rear hydraulic shock absorbers to ensure a smooth ride.

The Yadea EPOC is a luxury electric scooter designed for city commuting, combining enhanced power, handling, and quality with a sleek, modern appearance. It boasts Yadea's unique Graphene Battery, which offers a lifespan three times longer than conventional batteries and allows for extended travel distances. The scooter is powered by a 72V 38Ah TTFAR Graphene Battery, designed and manufactured by Yadea, ensuring consistent quality and performance.
With a peak power of 3200W, the Yadea EPOC can reach speeds of up to 74 km/h in Sports Mode and 60 km/h in TTFAR Long Range Mode. It offers a maximum torque of 150N·m and can handle inclines of up to 16°, making it suitable for various terrains.
One of the key features of the Yadea EPOC is its TTFAR Energy Retrieving Controller, which allows the battery to recharge while riding. The system converts kinetic energy into electric energy during activities like sliding, downhill riding, and braking, effectively extending the scooter's range.
The EPOC also boasts a comprehensive LED lighting system, designed to provide maximum visibility with low energy consumption. With a brightness of 30,000 cd and a visibility distance of 60 meters, the LED grille lighting ensures safe and clear navigation, especially at night.
Practicality is another highlight of the Yadea EPOC. It offers 30 liters of storage space, ample pedal space, and a comfortable saddle, making it well-suited for daily commuting needs. The scooter also features a 7-inch HD digital dashboard that provides all necessary information at a glance.
The Yadea EPOC introduces a mobile app with Bluetooth connectivity, enhancing user convenience. The app allows for features like unlocking the scooter and customizing settings. Once the scooter is paired with the user's app via a QR code, only the user can operate it, adding an extra layer of security.

Features: Motor and Performance; Battery and Range; Safety and Comfort; Design and Storage
Description:
The Yadea Ezeego is an electric scooter designed for city travel, offering a blend of power, efficiency, and user-friendly features. It comes in different models, each with varying specifications to cater to diverse rider needs.
Motor and Performance: The Ezeego is equipped with a rear wheel hub motor, with models offering rated powers ranging from 1.2 kW to 3 kW. The top model, ES151 P, delivers a maximum continuous power of 4.9 kW, allowing it to reach speeds up to 80 km/h and handle inclines up to 17 degrees. This ensures swift acceleration and the ability to navigate various terrains with ease.
Battery and Range: Depending on the model, the Ezeego utilizes either a 72V 38Ah graphene battery or a 72V 27Ah lithium battery. The ES151 P model features dual 72V 20Ah ternary lithium batteries, providing a maximum range of up to 104 km on a single charge. These removable batteries are lightweight and can be charged conveniently anywhere, making them ideal for daily commuting.
Smart Features: The scooter boasts a smart unlocking system, offering multiple access options such as NFC, Bluetooth, and the Yadea App. This modern approach eliminates the need for traditional keys, enhancing user convenience. Additionally, the high-resolution 7-inch VA dashboard adjusts its brightness according to ambient light, ensuring clear visibility without straining the rider's eyes.
Safety and Comfort: Safety is prioritized with features like 12-inch all-season hot melt tires that adapt to various road conditions and a disc braking system on both front and rear wheels for reliable stopping power. The Ezeego is designed to perform well in rainy conditions, featuring waterproof components and a ground clearance of 120 mm, allowing riders to navigate through wet roads confidently.
Design and Storage: The scooter's sleek design includes a V-shaped dual-lens headlamp, providing excellent illumination with a brightness of 28,000 cd and a visibility distance of over 50 meters. Practicality is enhanced with a 30-liter storage space under the seat, accommodating personal belongings or a helmet. Additional conveniences include USB charging ports to keep devices powered on the go.
specs: Class C LED dual lens headlamp

Description:
KTM has unveiled the 2026 KTM 390 Adventure R, a motorcycle that redefines the middleweight adventure segment with its rally-inspired design and enhanced off-road capabilities. At the heart of this machine lies the latest generation LC4c engine, now expanded to 399 cc, delivering increased power and smoother acceleration while maintaining a lightweight profile. This advancement ensures compliance with EURO 5.2 emission standards, reflecting KTM's commitment to performance and environmental responsibility.
The 390 Adventure R's chassis and bodywork draw clear inspiration from KTM's Dakar-winning bikes, featuring a raised front fender, vertical windscreen, and sleek rear section that emphasize its agility and robustness. The tubular steel frame and custom-designed sub-frame offer a balance of durability and lightness, essential for demanding off-road conditions.
Equipped with 21-inch front and 18-inch rear heavy-duty spoked wheels, paired with Mitas Enduro Trail E07+ tires, the bike is primed for challenging terrains. The WP suspension system provides 230 mm of adjustable travel at both ends, ensuring superior handling and comfort across various landscapes.
Advanced rider aids such as Cornering Motorcycle Traction Control (MTC), Cornering ABS, and Offroad ABS enhance safety and control, allowing riders to confidently navigate diverse environments. The 14-liter fuel tank offers substantial range, making it suitable for extended adventures.
specs: Floating disk, Bybre radial calipers with 2 pistons
ByBre, single-piston, floating caliper, brake disc

Description:
The Yadea E8S 2026 is an advanced electric scooter designed for efficient and comfortable urban travel. It features a powerful 2000W motor that allows it to reach speeds up to 60 km/h, providing swift and reliable transportation.
One of the standout features of the E8S is its impressive range. Equipped with a 72V38Ah graphene battery, it can travel up to 150 kilometers on a single charge under optimal conditions. This battery is also highly durable, capable of enduring up to 1,000 charge-discharge cycles, which is three times longer than conventional batteries.
The scooter's design emphasizes both aesthetics and functionality. It boasts a long-lasting grilled paint finish and is constructed with motorcycle-grade body materials, ensuring durability and a sleek appearance. For enhanced visibility and safety, it comes with a distinctive three-lens headlight and Yadea's iconic taillight.
Rider comfort is a priority in the E8S's design. It offers a spacious 360mm pedal area and a 650mm seat length, accommodating riders comfortably even on longer journeys. The scooter is equipped with front and rear disc brakes and hydraulic shock absorbers, providing a smooth and secure ride. Additionally, it features a generous 32-liter storage compartment under the seat, offering ample space for personal belongings.
The E8S 2026 also includes a smart, colorful dashboard that displays different colors to reflect various riding statuses, keeping the rider informed at all times.

The Yadea GFX 2026 is an affordable electric scooter designed for urban commuters and those seeking a stylish and eco-friendly mode of transportation. It boasts a sleek and aerodynamic design, incorporating advanced technology and premium features. The scooter is equipped with a reliable electric motor that delivers impressive acceleration and top speed, making it suitable for navigating city traffic with ease. The Yadea GFX 2026 also features a long-range battery that provides ample power for daily commutes and longer rides. Additionally, it offers a comfortable riding experience with its ergonomic seat, adjustable suspension, and efficient braking system. The scooter is also equipped with a smart digital display that provides real-time information on speed, battery level, and other important metrics.

The Yadea T5 2026 is an electric scooter designed for efficient and eco-friendly urban travel. It features a 72V 26Ah Graphene battery, providing a range of up to 105 kilometers on a single charge. The scooter can reach a top speed of 50 km/h, making it suitable for city commuting.
Charging the Yadea T5 takes approximately 5 to 6 hours, and a full charge consumes about 2.5 units of electricity, highlighting its cost-effectiveness
A standout feature of the T5 is its TTFAR technology, which includes regenerative braking. This system converts kinetic energy into electrical energy during deceleration, extending the scooter's range and enhancing energy efficiency.
For rider comfort, the Yadea T5 is equipped with cushioned seats, a backrest, and a footrest for passengers. It also offers practical features like under-seat storage, a USB charging port, and an LED display that provides real-time battery information.
Safety is addressed with front disc brakes, rear drum brakes, and dual shock absorbers, ensuring a smooth and secure ride. The scooter's design includes daytime running lights (DRLs) and LED headlights for improved visibility.

The 2026 Yadea M6L is an electric scooter designed for city travel, combining style, performance, and user-friendly features. It is powered by a 1,500W motor, allowing it to reach speeds up to 45 km/h, making it suitable for urban commuting.
The scooter features a 60V 20Ah removable lithium battery, providing a range of approximately 45-50 km on a single charge. This battery is lightweight and can be easily removed for convenient charging at home or work.
Constructed with high-strength cold-rolled structural steel, the M6L's frame is both durable and lightweight, having undergone rigorous testing to ensure longevity and reliability.
The scooter's design emphasizes rider comfort and safety. It features a classic and ergonomic design, with a two-seater saddle that includes a comfortable backrest for the passenger. The M6L is equipped with full LED headlights, providing high brightness and exceptional beam range for maximum visibility in various light and weather conditions.
For braking, the M6L uses a 180mm front brake disc and a rear drum brake, ensuring effective stopping power. The suspension system includes a 30mm diameter telescopic fork with 70mm travel at the front, and a double shock absorber with 60mm travel at the rear, offering a smooth ride over different road surfaces.
Additional features include a spacious under-seat storage compartment, suitable for stowing small accessories, and an LCD instrument panel that is easy to read, displaying essential information such as speed and battery status.
The M6L 2026 model is available in multiple colors, coated with high-quality Swedish Becker Paint, ensuring the scooter remains dazzling and eye-catching even after prolonged use.
specs: Front Disc Brake and Rear Brake

Description: The Husqvarna FE 250 2026 is a high-performance enduro motorcycle designed for tackling the most challenging off-road terrain. It boasts a powerful and refined single-cylinder, four-stroke engine that delivers smooth, controllable power across the entire rev range. The lightweight chromium-molybdenum steel frame, combined with advanced WP suspension, ensures exceptional handling and agility, allowing riders to navigate technical sections with confidence. The FE 250's sleek and functional design, featuring high-quality components like Brembo brakes and a Magura hydraulic clutch, provides optimal control and rider comfort. Additionally, its electronic fuel injection and traction control system offer seamless performance and enhanced rider safety in various conditions. The Husqvarna FE 250 2026 is a top contender in the enduro segment, catering to both experienced riders and those seeking a thrilling and rewarding off-road experience.
specs: DDS wet multi-disc clutch, Braktec hydraulics

Description: The Husqvarna FE 350 2026 is a high-performance enduro motorcycle designed for tackling the most challenging off-road terrain. It boasts a powerful 350cc single-cylinder, four-stroke engine that delivers smooth, controllable power across a wide range of RPMs. The engine is paired with a lightweight and durable chromoly steel frame, providing exceptional handling and agility. Equipped with advanced WP XACT suspension, the FE 350 offers superior shock absorption and traction control, allowing riders to confidently navigate through rocks, roots, and mud. The bike also features a hydraulic clutch, Brembo brakes, and Michelin Enduro tires, ensuring optimal performance and control in demanding conditions. The FE 350's sleek design, ergonomic seating, and lightweight construction make it a comfortable and enjoyable ride for both experienced and aspiring enduro riders.
specs: DDS wet multi-disc clutch, Braktec hydraulics

Description: The Husqvarna FE 450 2026 is a high-performance enduro motorcycle designed for off-road enthusiasts who demand power, precision, and reliability. It features a lightweight yet robust chrome-molybdenum steel frame that enhances handling and stability on challenging terrains. The bike is powered by a 450cc single-cylinder, fuel-injected engine, which offers strong, controllable power while remaining efficient. The six-speed transmission, developed by PANKL, ensures smooth gear changes, and the advanced DDS (damped diaphragm steel) clutch provides durability and easy operation. The FE 450 2026 model comes with WP XPLOR suspension, providing excellent adjustability and comfort for rough trails or competitive riding. Its ergonomics are designed for rider comfort, with a slim profile, grippy seat, and optimal weight distribution. Additional features include high-performance Brembo brakes, lightweight wheels, and a modern exhaust system that reduces noise and emissions while maintaining peak performance. This bike is perfect for riders who want a blend of cutting-edge technology, premium components, and rugged durability for any off-road adventure.
specs: DDS wet multi-disc clutch, Braktec hydraulics

Description:
The 2026 Husqvarna FE 501 is a powerful off-road motorcycle designed for serious riders who demand top performance. It is powered by a high-performance 510.9cc single-cylinder, four-stroke engine, delivering impressive power and torque, ideal for challenging terrains. The bike features advanced electronic fuel injection for smooth throttle response and efficient power delivery. Its lightweight chromium-molybdenum steel frame provides exceptional handling and durability. The WP XACT suspension system, with fully adjustable front and rear components, ensures excellent stability and control over rough terrain.
This model also includes a lightweight aluminum subframe and a high-quality Brembo braking system for precise stopping power. Riders will appreciate the ergonomically designed seat and bodywork, which allow better control and comfort during long rides. Additionally, the FE 501 is equipped with modern features like an electric starter, traction control, and multiple ride modes to suit various conditions. With its sleek design and premium components, the Husqvarna FE 501 2026 is a top-tier choice for off-road enthusiasts looking for a reliable and high-performing motorcycle.
specs: DDS wet multi-disc clutch, Braktec hydraulics

Description: The Husqvarna TX 300 2026 is a new dirt bike designed for serious enduro and cross-country enthusiasts. It features a powerful 293.2cc, single-cylinder, two-stroke engine equipped with advanced fuel injection, delivering smooth and responsive power across all terrains. The bike has an electric starter for convenience and a lightweight build, thanks to its chromium-molybdenum steel frame and carbon composite subframe, which enhance durability and handling. The suspension is top-notch, with WP XACT forks and a WP XACT rear shock offering exceptional control and comfort on rough trails. The TX 300 2026 model also comes with a PANKL Racing Systems gearbox and a DDS (Damped Diaphragm Steel) clutch, ensuring precise gear changes and minimal effort during aggressive riding. With its high ground clearance, agile chassis, and off-road tires, it is perfectly suited for challenging terrains. Additional features include a large fuel tank for extended rides, Brembo brakes for reliable stopping power, and modern graphics for a stylish look. This bike is a great choice for riders looking for performance, reliability, and cutting-edge technology in an off-road package.
specs: Wet, DDS multi-disc clutch, Brembo hydraulics

Description: The Husqvarna FX 350 2026 is a brand-new motocross bike designed for serious off-road enthusiasts. It features a powerful 350cc four-stroke engine that delivers exceptional power and torque, making it ideal for tackling challenging terrain. The bike's lightweight chassis and advanced suspension system provide exceptional handling and agility, allowing riders to navigate tight corners and jumps with ease. The FX 350 2026 also boasts a number of high-quality components, including Brembo brakes, WP suspension, and a Magura hydraulic clutch, ensuring top-notch performance and reliability. Whether you're a seasoned pro or just starting out, the Husqvarna FX 350 2026 is a thrilling and capable machine that will take your off-road riding to the next level.
specs: Wet multi-disc DS clutch, Brembo hydraulics

Description: The Husqvarna FX 450 2026 is a top-of-the-line motocross bike that is specifically designed for serious riders who crave high-performance capabilities. At the heart of this powerful machine lies a robust 449.9cc single-cylinder engine, expertly engineered to deliver exceptional power and torque that makes it more than capable of tackling even the most demanding and challenging tracks with ease. The bike's lightweight yet incredibly strong frame, combined with its advanced suspension system, provides riders with exceptional handling and agility, allowing them to navigate even the tightest corners and most daunting jumps with confidence and precision. Furthermore, the FX 450 boasts an impressive array of high-quality components, including industry-leading Brembo brakes, renowned WP suspension, and ultra-grippy Michelin tires, all of which come together to ensure top-notch performance, durability, and reliability. Whether you're a seasoned professional rider or an aspiring amateur looking to take your skills to the next level, the Husqvarna FX 450 2026 is a formidable machine that is sure to push your riding skills to the limit, delivering an unparalleled riding experience that is sure to leave you breathless.
specs: Wet, DDS multi-disc clutch, Brembo hydraulics

Description:
The 2026 Husqvarna TC 125 is the latest addition to the motocross world, boasting cutting-edge features that promise unparalleled performance. This bike has been meticulously crafted to provide riders with a formidable machine that excels in agility, power, and handling.
Engine Performance
At the heart of the TC 125 lies a compact and lightweight 124.8cc two-stroke engine, expertly engineered to produce a potent burst of power. The engine's design features a 54mm bore and 54.5mm stroke, ensuring a remarkable power-to-weight ratio.
Chassis and Suspension
The bike showcases innovative chassis components, including a hydroformed chromium molybdenum frame renowned for its exceptional strength and durability. The WP Suspension system provides unparalleled damping and stability, enabling riders to tackle demanding terrain with poise and precision.
Ergonomic and Functional Features
The TC 125 boasts an array of ergonomic and functional features designed to enhance the riding experience. The sleek bodywork provides unhindered movement and comfort, while the compact seat and tank design facilitate effortless shifting of body weight.
Key Features
Compact and lightweight 124.8cc two-stroke engine
Hydroformed chromium molybdenum frame
WP Suspension system with 48mm split-air fork and linked monoshock
Sleek and slender bodywork with stylish graphics and decals
Compact seat and tank design for effortless body weight shifting
Conclusion
With its unbeatable combination of power, agility, and style, the 2026 Husqvarna TC 125 is poised to dominate the motocross scene, providing aspiring champions with the ultimate tool to unleash their full potential.
specs: Wet multi-disc DS clutch, Brembo hydraulics

Description: The Husqvarna FC 250 2026 is a motocross bike designed for serious racers. It features a powerful and compact 250cc four-stroke engine, delivering exceptional power and responsiveness. The bike's lightweight chromium-molybdenum frame is engineered for optimal stiffness and flexibility, providing precise handling and agility on the track. Equipped with top-of-the-line WP XACT suspension, the FC 250 offers superior shock absorption and control, even in the most demanding conditions. The bike's refined ergonomics and sleek bodywork allow for effortless rider movement and control, while its advanced electronics, including traction control and launch control, provide a competitive edge. Finished with premium components, such as an FMF silencer, Dunlop tires, and Rockstar Energy Husqvarna Factory Racing graphics, the FC 250 2026 is a true race-ready machine built for winning.
specs: Wet multi-disc DS clutch, Brembo hydraulics

Description: The Husqvarna FC 350 2026 is a motocross bike designed for riders who want a balance of power and agility. Its 349.7cc engine sits perfectly between the smaller 250cc and larger 450cc engines, offering a versatile blend of speed and control. The bike features advanced fuel injection for smooth power delivery and a lightweight, chromium-molybdenum steel frame for excellent handling. The suspension system, powered by WP XACT forks and a WP XACT rear shock, ensures stability and comfort on rough tracks. It comes with Brembo hydraulic brakes for strong stopping power and a multifunctional map switch to adjust the engine settings according to the terrain. The bodywork is ergonomically designed to enhance rider comfort and control, while the graphics give it a modern and sharp look. It also features electric start, ensuring quick and easy ignition, and lightweight wheels with Dunlop tires for top performance in all conditions.
specs: Wet multi-disc DS clutch, Brembo hydraulics

Description: The Husqvarna FC 450 2026 is a high-performance motocross bike designed for serious riders. It features a powerful 449.9cc single-cylinder engine, delivering exceptional power and torque, making it capable of tackling the most demanding tracks. The bike's lightweight chromoly steel frame and advanced suspension system provide excellent handling and stability, allowing riders to navigate corners with precision and confidence. The FC 450 2026 also boasts high-quality components, including Brembo brakes, Dunlop tires, and WP XACT suspension, ensuring optimal performance and durability. With its combination of power, agility, and cutting-edge technology, the Husqvarna FC 450 2026 is a top contender in the motocross world, ready to take on the toughest challenges and deliver thrilling rides.
specs: Wet multi-disc DS clutch, Brembo hydraulics

Description: The Husqvarna Norden 901 2026 is an adventure motorcycle designed for both on-road and off-road riding. It features a powerful 889 cc parallel-twin engine that delivers strong low-end torque, making it suitable for tackling challenging terrain. The Norden 901 is equipped with long-travel suspension, tubeless spoked wheels, and knobby tires, providing excellent off-road capability. It also features a comfortable riding position, a large fuel tank, and a host of electronic rider aids, including multiple riding modes, traction control, and cornering ABS. With its rugged design, advanced technology, and versatile capabilities, the Husqvarna Norden 901 2026 is a capable and exciting adventure motorcycle for riders who want to explore both on and off the beaten path.
specs: Liquid cooled with water/oil heat exchanger
Forced oil lubrication with 2 oil pumps
2 x 4-piston caliper, radially mounted, brake disc
Chromium-Molybdenum-Steel frame using the engine as stressed element, powder coated
Stainless steel primary and secondary silencer

Description: The Husqvarna Vitpilen 401 2026 is a sleek and stylish motorcycle designed for urban riding and weekend adventures. It boasts a minimalist aesthetic with clean lines, exposed trellis frame, and premium components. Powered by a 398cc liquid-cooled single-cylinder engine, it delivers a punchy performance with 33kW of power and 37Nm of torque. The engine is paired with a 6-speed manual gearbox for smooth and efficient gear shifts. Equipped with high-quality WP suspension, both front and rear, and powerful ByBre brakes with dual-channel ABS, the Vitpilen 401 offers a comfortable and confident ride. Its lightweight construction and nimble handling make it easy to maneuver through city traffic and navigate tight corners. The digital instrument cluster provides essential information at a glance, while the LED lighting ensures excellent visibility. The Vitpilen 401's distinctive design and impressive performance make it a standout choice for riders seeking a unique and exhilarating riding experience.
specs: Forced oil lubrication with 2 oil pumps
Bosch 9.3 MP (with cornering ABS and SUPERMOTO ABS)
ByBre, opposed four-piston caliper, brake disc
Stainless steel silencer with regulated catalytic converter

Description: The 2026 Husqvarna 701 Supermoto is a high-performance motorcycle that seamlessly blends street and off-road capabilities. Its powerful 692.7cc single-cylinder engine delivers exhilarating acceleration and responsive power, while the lightweight chassis and agile handling make it easy to navigate through urban environments and twisty back roads alike. The advanced suspension system, featuring top-of-the-line WP components, provides exceptional handling and comfort on varied surfaces. Additionally, the bike is equipped with cutting-edge technology, including a full-color TFT display that provides essential information at a glance, and ride-by-wire throttle for precise control. Whether you're a seasoned rider or newcomer, the 2026 Husqvarna 701 Supermoto offers an unforgettable riding experience.
specs: Keihin EMS with RBW, twin ignition
Forced oil lubrication with 2 oil pumps
Two-channel Bosch 9.1 MP ABS (incl. Cornering ABS and Supermoto mode Disengegable)
Brembo four-piston radial fixed calliper, brake disc
Brembo single-piston floating calliper, brake disc
Chromium-Molybdenum steel trellis frame, powder coated
Spoked wheels with aluminium tubeless rims

Description: The Husqvarna TC 85 2026 is an affordable motocross bike designed for young riders, bridging the gap between the smaller TC 65 and full-size motocross machines. Its lightweight chromium-molybdenum steel frame houses a powerful 84.9cc two-stroke engine, delivering exceptional torque and power. The bike features adjustable WP suspension and a new single-piece swingarm, providing exceptional agility and confident handling. The refined ergonomics and striking new graphics of the 2026 TC 85 create a bold, fresh look that appeals to young riders.
specs: XACT 43 WP Upside-Down fork, Ø 43 mm

Description: The Husqvarna TC 50 2026 is a small motocross bike designed specifically for young riders. It boasts a powerful 2-stroke engine, delivering exceptional acceleration and top speed, allowing young riders to experience the thrill of motocross racing. The bike's lightweight and durable frame, combined with adjustable ergonomics, ensures optimal control and comfort for riders of different sizes. Equipped with top-of-the-line WP suspension, the TC 50 provides exceptional handling and absorbs bumps with ease, enhancing rider confidence and safety. With its competition-focused specifications and premium components, the TC 50 2026 sets the standard for 50cc motocross bikes, providing young riders with a distinct advantage on the racetrack.
specs: XACT 35 WP Upside-Down fork, Ø 35 mm

Description:
The Husqvarna Svartpilen 401 2026 is a modern motorcycle designed for city adventures. Its name, meaning "Black Arrow," reflects its sleek and minimalist design. The bike is powered by a 398.6 cc single-cylinder, liquid-cooled engine that produces 33 kW of power and 39 Nm of torque. This engine meets the latest Euro5+ emission standards, ensuring it is environmentally friendly.
The Svartpilen 401 2026 features a 6-speed manual transmission, allowing for smooth gear changes. It has a lightweight steel trellis frame, which contributes to its agility and ease of handling. The bike's suspension system includes adjustable WP Apex USD forks at the front and a WP Apex monoshock at the rear, providing a comfortable ride over various road surfaces.
Safety is a priority with the Svartpilen 401. It comes equipped with dual-channel ABS (Anti-lock Braking System) for both front and rear disc brakes, enhancing braking performance and rider confidence. The front brake features a 320 mm disc, while the rear has a 240 mm disc.
The motorcycle's design includes modern LED lighting for both the headlight and taillight, improving visibility. It rides on 17-inch spoked wheels fitted with Pirelli Scorpion Rally STR tires, sized 110/70 at the front and 150/60 at the rear, offering good grip and stability.
For rider convenience, the Svartpilen 401 is equipped with a 5-inch TFT (Thin Film Transistor) display that provides clear information such as speed, fuel level, and gear position. It also features Bluetooth connectivity, allowing riders to connect their smartphones for functions like answering calls, playing music, and using navigation through the Ride Husqvarna Motorcycles app.
The bike has a fuel tank capacity of approximately 13 liters, offering a decent range for city commuting. It weighs around 159 kg without fuel, making it relatively light and easy to maneuver in urban environments. The seat height is set at 820 mm, accommodating a wide range of riders.
specs: Forced oil lubrication with 2 oil pumps
Bosch 9.3 MP (with cornering ABS and SUPERMOTO ABS)
ByBre, opposed four-piston caliper, brake disc
Stainless steel silencer with regulated catalytic converter

Description:
Designed to tackle the most demanding off-road terrain, the Husqvarna TE 300 Pro 2026 is a force to be reckoned with in the world of enduro motorcycles. This high-performance machine is engineered to deliver exceptional power, agility, and reliability, making it an ideal choice for experienced riders seeking a thrilling off-road experience. For riders seeking a more accessible entry point into the world of enduro, Husqvarna also offers the TE 300 2026, a more affordable variant that still packs a punch without compromising on performance.
Lightweight and Agile Chassis

The Husqvarna TE 300 Pro 2026 boasts an aggressive and sleek design, reflecting its high-performance capabilities and off-road prowess. In conclusion, the Husqvarna TE 300 Pro 2026 is a top-tier enduro motorcycle that embodies the perfect blend of power, agility, and reliability. The 2026 Honda ICON e: is a compact electric scooter designed for urban commuting, particularly appealing to students and city dwellers. It features a 1.81 kW in-wheel brushless motor that delivers a top speed of 55 km/h and a maximum torque of 85 Nm, ensuring smooth acceleration and performance suitable for city traffic.
Equipped with a 48V lithium-ion battery with a capacity of 30.6 Ah, the ICON e: offers a range of up to 53 km on a single charge. Charging the battery from 0% to 100% takes approximately 7 hours and 20 minutes, while a partial charge from 25% to 75% can be achieved in about 3 hours and 30 minutes. With its refined engine dynamics, this bike provides ample power for navigating congested city streets, cruising down highways, and exploring scenic routes. Whether you're a seasoned rider or a newcomer to the world of motorcycling, the Lifan KP350 2026's engine is sure to impress.

The Lifan KP350 2026 boasts a comfortable riding position, carefully designed to reduce fatigue and enhance overall ride quality. The Zero SR/F 2026 is a premium electric motorcycle known for its modern design, powerful performance, and advanced technology. It is powered by a Z-Force 75-10 motor, producing an impressive 111 horsepower and 140 lb-ft of torque, making it incredibly fast and responsive. Its top speed is around 124 mph (200 km/h), which is excellent for an electric bike. The motorcycle uses a 15.1+ kWh battery, which can be upgraded to 17.3 kWh with an additional power pack. This setup provides a range of up to 176 miles (city riding) on a full charge. The Zero SR/F also features a lightweight trellis frame for improved handling and stability. It is equipped with high-quality suspension from Showa and powerful dual radial-mounted front brakes from J.Juan, ensuring a safe and smooth ride. The bike’s advanced Cypress II operating system integrates with its BOSCH Motorcycle Stability Control (MSC), which includes features like cornering ABS, traction control, and drag torque control for better grip and control in various conditions.
Riders can enjoy a customizable experience with different riding modes such as Eco, Sport, Street, Rain, and up to 10 user-defined modes. The bike also has a full-color TFT display and smartphone connectivity, allowing riders to monitor performance data, adjust settings, and locate charging stations through the Zero app. With its sleek look, impressive range, and state-of-the-art features, the Zero SR/F 2026 is perfect for anyone seeking a high-performance electric motorcycle for daily commuting or exciting weekend rides.

It features a new 452cc single-cylinder, liquid-cooled engine, known as the 'Sherpa 450', producing 40 horsepower at 8,000 rpm and 40 Nm of torque at 5,500 rpm. This engine is paired with a 6-speed gearbox that includes a slip-and-assist clutch for smoother gear shifts.
The bike is built on a twin-spar frame and is equipped with Showa suspension components: 43mm upside-down front forks and a preload-adjustable rear monoshock, both offering 200mm of travel. This setup provides a ground clearance of 230mm, suitable for various terrains. The Himalayan 450 rides on 21-inch front and 17-inch rear wire-spoke wheels fitted with dual-purpose tubed tires, sized 90/90-21 at the front and 140/80-17 at the rear.

The motorcycle's seat height is adjustable between 825mm and 845mm with the standard seat, and a lower seat option reduces it to between 805mm and 825mm. With a fully fueled 17-liter tank, the Himalayan 450 has a kerb weight of 198kg.
In terms of technology, the Himalayan 450 is the first Royal Enfield model to feature riding modes—Eco and Performance—and comes with a color TFT instrument cluster that supports smartphone connectivity via Bluetooth. This display offers navigation, music playback, and call management. The bike also includes all-LED lighting, with the taillight integrated into the rear indicators.

The 2026 Bullet 350 offers improved comfort and handling thanks to a new double-cradle frame and refined suspension setup. This setup features telescopic forks in the front and twin shock absorbers at the rear. It also includes a disc brake system with dual-channel ABS for safer braking. Wider tires provide better grip and stability.
Ergonomics are rider-friendly, with a well-padded single seat designed for long rides. Royal Enfield has introduced modern features like LED lighting and a USB charging port, making the bike suitable for urban commutes and highway cruising.

Description:

The 2026 Royal Enfield Interceptor 650 continues to impress motorcycle enthusiasts with its perfect blend of classic style and modern performance. This iconic bike has retained its timeless design, making it a favorite among riders who value both style and practicality.
Design and Features
The Interceptor 650 2026 boasts a teardrop-shaped fuel tank, a dual exhaust system, and an upright riding posture that ensures comfort during long rides. Its design is inspired by the classic motorcycles of the past, but with a modern twist. The bike's retro aesthetic is complemented by contemporary features such as LED lighting, a semi-digital instrument cluster, and optional connectivity for navigation and notifications.
Engine and Performance
At the heart of the Interceptor 650 is its 648cc parallel-twin engine. For the 2026 model, the engine has been tweaked for better refinement and compliance with the latest emission standards. The result is a smooth, linear power delivery and a distinctive exhaust note that's music to the ears of motorcycle enthusiasts. Whether you're cruising down the highway or carving through twisty roads, the Interceptor 650 delivers an exhilarating yet approachable riding experience.
Upgrades and Enhancements
For 2026, the Interceptor 650 receives several subtle enhancements that take its performance and practicality to the next level. These include:
Updated suspension tuning: Improved suspension ensures a smoother ride and better handling, making the Interceptor 650 an excellent choice for both short trips and long-distance tours.
Improved ergonomics: The bike's ergonomics have been refined to provide a more comfortable riding experience, with a focus on reducing fatigue during extended rides.
Advanced rider aids: The Interceptor 650 now features a slipper clutch and dual-channel ABS, enhancing safety and control for riders of all skill levels.
Color Schemes and Customization
The 2026 Interceptor 650 introduces new color schemes, catering to riders who want to add a personal touch to their motorcycle. Whether you prefer classic colors or bold, modern hues, there's an Interceptor 650 to suit your style.

The motorcycle features a steel tubular double cradle frame, ensuring stability and precise handling. Its suspension system comprises telescopic front forks and twin rear shock absorbers with adjustable preload, offering a comfortable ride across various terrains. Braking is handled by a 320 mm front disc and a 240 mm rear disc, both equipped with dual-channel ABS for enhanced safety.
In terms of dimensions, the Continental GT 650 has a wheelbase of 1,398 mm, a seat height of 820 mm, and a ground clearance of 174 mm. It weighs 214 kg and comes with a 12.5-liter fuel tank, suitable for both city commutes and longer journeys.
The 2026 model introduces several modern features, including an LED headlamp that enhances visibility while maintaining a classic look. The blacked-out variants come with cast alloy wheels fitted with tubeless tires, providing peace of mind on long rides. Premium aluminum switch cubes offer improved grip and feel, and a USB port ensures on-the-go charging, keeping riders connected wherever they go.

Description:
The Royal Enfield Shotgun 650 is a versatile motorcycle that combines classic design with modern features. It is powered by a 648cc parallel-twin engine, delivering 34.6 kW of power at 7,250 rpm and 52.3 Nm of torque at 5,650 rpm, providing strong performance for various riding conditions.
The bike features a modular design, allowing it to switch between single-seater, double-seater, and luggage-carrying configurations with ease. This adaptability makes it suitable for both city commuting and longer tours.
Ergonomically, the Shotgun 650 offers a comfortable riding experience, with mid-set footpegs, a low seat height of 795 mm, and well-positioned handlebars. The suspension system includes a 41mm Showa Big Piston Fork with 120 mm travel at the front and twin shocks with preload adjustment and 101 mm travel at the rear, ensuring a smooth ride on various terrains.

The Shotgun 650 comes with modern amenities such as an LED headlamp and tail lamp, a digital-analog instrument console, and a USB charging port. It also includes the Royal Enfield Tripper navigation system, enhancing convenience for riders.
With a fuel tank capacity of 13.8 liters and a fuel efficiency of approximately 22 kmpl, the Shotgun 650 offers a decent range for long rides.

Description:
The Royal Enfield Hunter 350 2026 is a stylish and compact motorcycle designed for both city riding and relaxed cruising. It features a 349cc, single-cylinder, air-oil-cooled engine that produces around 20.2 horsepower and 27 Nm of torque, providing smooth and steady performance. The bike utilizes the same trusted J-platform as other Royal Enfield 350 models, ensuring reliability and a refined ride experience. It comes with a 5-speed gearbox for precise shifting, making it easy to handle in various conditions.
The Hunter 350 boasts a retro-modern design, blending classic elements like a round headlamp and teardrop fuel tank with modern touches, such as vibrant paint schemes and sleek bodywork. It offers comfortable ergonomics with a slightly sporty riding stance, thanks to its low seat height of approximately 765mm and wide handlebars. This makes it ideal for riders of all skill levels. The bike weighs around 202 kg, making it lighter and more nimble than other Royal Enfield models.
For suspension, the Hunter 350 employs telescopic forks in the front and twin rear shock absorbers, ensuring a comfortable ride over rough roads. It comes equipped with disc brakes on both wheels and a dual-channel ABS system for enhanced safety. The wheels are 17-inch alloys fitted with tubeless tires, giving it a sporty look and better road grip.
The motorcycle features a semi-digital instrument cluster, providing essential information like speed, fuel level, and trip meter, along with an optional Tripper navigation system for turn-by-turn directions. It has a 13-liter fuel tank, giving a good range for both city and highway rides. The Hunter 350 is available in multiple colors and variants, catering to riders who want a combination of retro charm and modern features.

Description:
The 2026 Royal Enfield Super Meteor 650 is a cruiser motorcycle designed for comfortable long-distance rides. It features a 648cc parallel-twin, air-oil cooled engine that produces 47 horsepower at 7,250 rpm and 52.3 Nm of torque at 5,650 rpm, providing smooth acceleration and responsive throttle control.
The bike is equipped with a 6-speed manual transmission and a wet, multi-plate clutch, ensuring seamless gear shifts. Its low-slung, wide seat and relaxed riding posture enhance comfort during extended journeys. The Super Meteor 650 comes with a spacious teardrop-shaped fuel tank that holds up to 15.7 liters of fuel, allowing for longer rides without frequent refueling.
For improved handling, the motorcycle features 43mm upside-down (USD) front forks with 120mm travel and twin rear shocks with preload adjustment and 101mm travel, offering a balanced and controlled ride on various terrains. Safety is enhanced with dual-channel ABS, utilizing a 320mm front disc and a 300mm rear disc for effective braking performance.
The Super Meteor 650 is fitted with alloy wheels and tubeless tires, including a wider rear tire for better traction and stability at higher speeds. It also boasts modern LED lighting, including a new headlamp that combines classic design with LED technology for improved visibility and reduced power consumption. The semi-digital instrument cluster features an analog speedometer and a digital display, providing essential ride information, and includes built-in Tripper navigation for easy route guidance.
With a seat height of 740mm and a ground clearance of 135mm, the Super Meteor 650 is accessible to a wide range of riders. Its overall dimensions are 2,260mm in length, 890mm in width, and 1,155mm in height, with a wheelbase of 1,500mm, contributing to its stable and comfortable cruising characteristics. It is powered by a reliable 349cc, single-cylinder, air-cooled engine that delivers smooth performance with 20.2 horsepower and 27 Nm of torque. This engine is paired with a 5-speed gearbox, ensuring a comfortable and responsive ride, whether in the city or on highways. The bike features a sturdy dual-cradle frame, providing stability and durability on various terrains. For rider comfort, the Classic 350 2026 comes with wide handlebars, a well-padded seat, and a relaxed riding position.
The bike is equipped with advanced technology, including a semi-digital instrument cluster that displays essential information like fuel level, trip meter, and a digital clock. Additionally, it features a Tripper navigation system, which pairs with your smartphone via Bluetooth for turn-by-turn directions. The Classic 350 ensures safety with dual-channel ABS (Anti-lock Braking System) and disc brakes on both wheels, offering excellent braking performance. With its timeless design, the Classic 350 boasts round headlamps, a teardrop-shaped fuel tank, and chrome accents that give it a vintage charm. Combining old-school aesthetics with modern engineering, the Royal Enfield Classic 350 2026 is perfect for riders who love both style and performance.

The Royal Enfield Meteor 350 2026 is a cruiser motorcycle designed for comfortable long-distance rides. It features a 349cc single-cylinder, air-cooled engine that produces 20.2 horsepower at 6,100 rpm and 27 Nm of torque at 4,000 rpm. This engine uses a single overhead camshaft (SOHC) and fuel injection for smooth and efficient performance.
Built on a twin-downtube spine frame, the Meteor 350 offers improved stability and handling. The front suspension consists of 41mm telescopic forks with 130mm travel, while the rear features twin-tube shock absorbers with six-step adjustable preload, ensuring a comfortable ride over various terrains.

The Meteor 350 features a low and wide split seat with a padded backrest, providing all-day riding comfort for both the rider and passenger. The digi-analog instrument cluster includes a floating LCD screen and the Tripper navigation system, offering essential ride information and turn-by-turn directions.
With a fuel tank capacity of 15 liters and a ground clearance of 170mm, the Meteor 350 is well-suited for extended journeys. It is available in multiple color options, allowing riders to choose a style that reflects their personal taste.

Description:
The 2026 Royal Enfield Guerrilla 450 is a modern roadster motorcycle that combines classic design with contemporary features. It is powered by a 452cc liquid-cooled, single-cylinder engine, producing 39.4 brake horsepower (bhp) at 8,000 revolutions per minute (rpm) and 40 Newton-meters (Nm) of torque at 5,500 rpm. This engine is paired with a six-speed gearbox and includes a slip-assist clutch for smoother gear shifts.
The bike offers two riding modes: Performance and Eco. Performance mode provides a more responsive throttle for spirited riding, while Eco mode optimizes fuel efficiency for longer journeys. The Guerrilla 450 features a steel twin-spar frame, utilizing the engine as a stressed member to enhance rigidity and handling. Its suspension system includes 43mm telescopic front forks with 140mm travel and a rear monoshock with 150mm travel, ensuring a comfortable ride over various terrains.
Braking is managed by a 310mm ventilated disc at the front and a 270mm disc at the rear, both equipped with dual-channel ABS for improved safety. The motorcycle rides on 17-inch wheels fitted with tubeless tires—120/70 at the front and 160/60 at the rear—providing stability and grip.
The Guerrilla 450 is available in three variants: Analogue, Dash, and Flash. The Analogue variant features a semi-digital instrument cluster, while the Dash and Flash variants come with a 4-inch TFT display offering smartphone connectivity, navigation, and music controls. All variants include LED lighting, with a retro-styled round headlamp and integrated LED tail light and indicators.
With a seat height of 780mm and a kerb weight of 185kg, the Guerrilla 450 is accessible to a wide range of riders. Its 11-liter fuel tank supports extended rides without frequent refueling.

The 2027 Kawasaki Z900RS is a motorcycle that blends classic design with modern performance. It features a 948cc liquid-cooled, inline four-cylinder engine, delivering 110 horsepower at 8,500 rpm and 72.3 lb-ft of torque at 6,500 rpm. This engine setup ensures strong acceleration and smooth performance, suitable for both city rides and highway cruising.
The bike's design pays homage to the original Z1, showcasing a retro style with modern touches. It includes a round LED headlight, an oval LED taillight, and bullet-shaped analog dials paired with a multi-function LCD screen, combining vintage aesthetics with contemporary functionality.
Rider comfort is prioritized with a well-cushioned seat and an upright riding position, making it suitable for longer journeys. The suspension system features a 41mm inverted telescopic front fork and a horizontal back-link rear suspension, both adjustable to cater to different riding preferences.
Safety and control are enhanced by the Anti-lock Brake System (ABS) and Kawasaki Traction Control (KTRC) with three modes, providing stability across various riding conditions. The Assist & Slipper Clutch ensures smoother gear shifts and prevents rear-wheel lock-up during sudden downshifts.
The Z900RS rides on 17-inch wheels, fitted with a 120/70 tire at the front and a 180/55 tire at the rear, offering a balanced and responsive ride. With a fuel capacity of 4.5 gallons and a curb weight of approximately 474 pounds, it balances fuel efficiency with manageable weight.

The seat height of 750mm ensures that riders of all sizes can comfortably ride the bike, making it an excellent choice for both seasoned bikers and newcomers alike. In terms of safety, the JAWA Perak 2026 features disc brakes on both the front and rear wheels, providing unparalleled stopping power and control. The bike's double-cradle tubular frame not only adds to its sleek and stylish design but also provides exceptional strength and durability, ensuring that the bike can withstand the rigors of daily riding. Overall, the JAWA Perak 2026 is an exceptional motorcycle that offers a perfect blend of power, style, and safety, making it a valuable investment for anyone looking to upgrade their ride.

Description: The Keeway Vieste 300 2026 is a maxi-scooter that boasts a powerful 278.2cc, liquid-cooled, four-valve engine, delivering a robust 18.4 bhp of power and 24 Nm of torque. Its sleek and modern design, coupled with features like a fully digital instrument cluster, LED lighting, and a spacious under-seat storage compartment, makes it a stylish and practical choice for urban commuting and weekend rides. The Vieste 300 also prioritizes safety with features such as disc brakes on both wheels and an anti-locking braking system (ABS).

The Lambretta X300 2026 is a modern scooter that beautifully blends classic Italian design with contemporary features. Powered by a 275cc single-cylinder, 4-stroke, 4-valve engine, it delivers a robust 18.5 kW of power at 8,250 rpm and a peak torque of 24.5 Nm at 6,250 rpm, ensuring a lively and responsive ride.
Built with a steel semi-monocoque chassis, the X300 maintains Lambretta's signature fixed front fender, a nod to its rich heritage. The scooter's dimensions are practical for urban commuting, measuring 1,922 mm in length, 741 mm in width, and 1,117 mm in height, with a wheelbase of 1,370 mm and a seat height of 790 mm. Weighing 165 kg and equipped with a 7-liter fuel tank, it strikes a balance between stability and maneuverability.
Safety and comfort are prioritized with features like the double arm-link front suspension and dual rear shock absorbers, providing a smooth ride over various terrains. The scooter is fitted with hydraulic disc brakes on both the front (ø220 mm) and rear (ø219 mm), complemented by a dual-channel ABS system for enhanced braking performance.
Modern conveniences include a keyless ignition system, allowing riders to start the scooter effortlessly. The semi-digital display combines an analog speedometer with a digital LCD screen, offering clear and accessible information. Full LED lighting, including the distinctive Lambretta front badge and tail light, ensures visibility and adds to the scooter's stylish appearance.

The Lambretta V200 2026 is a stylish scooter that blends classic Italian design with modern features. It is powered by a 168.9cc, four-stroke, air-cooled engine equipped with electronic fuel injection (EFI), delivering smooth and efficient performance. The engine is paired with a Continuously Variable Transmission (CVT) for seamless acceleration.
In terms of dimensions, the V200 measures 1,900 mm in length, 690 mm in width, and 1,130 mm in height, with a wheelbase of 1,330 mm and a seat height of 770 mm, providing a comfortable riding position. The scooter features a semi-monocoque steel frame, ensuring durability and stability. It rides on 12-inch alloy wheels fitted with 110/70-12 front and 120/70-12 rear tires, offering good grip and handling. The suspension system includes telescopic forks at the front and a double spring setup at the rear, contributing to a smooth and balanced ride.
For braking, the V200 is equipped with hydraulic disc brakes on both the front and rear, each measuring 220 mm in diameter. The scooter also features an Anti-lock Braking System (ABS) to distribute braking force evenly, enhancing safety during rides.
Aesthetically, the Lambretta V200 pays homage to its heritage with a full LED lighting system that incorporates the iconic Lambretta logo within both the headlight and rear light. The front grill design mirrors the classic look of the revered Li Series, adding to its nostalgic appeal. The semi-digital instrument cluster combines an analog speedometer with an LCD display, providing clear and precise information to the rider. Additionally, the scooter offers practical features such as a 12V charger for device charging on the go.

The Lambretta V125 2026 is a modern scooter that blends classic design with contemporary features. Powered by a 124.7cc, air-cooled, single-cylinder, 4-stroke engine, it delivers a maximum power of 10.19 PS at 8500 rpm and a peak torque of 9.2 Nm at 7000 rpm. This engine is managed by an Electronic Control Unit (ECU) ignition system and utilizes Electronic Fuel Injection (EFI) for efficient fuel delivery. The scooter is equipped with a Continuously Variable Transmission (CVT), ensuring smooth and effortless acceleration.
In terms of dimensions, the V125 measures 1,900 mm in length, 690 mm in width, and 1,130 mm in height, with a wheelbase of 1,330 mm. The seat height is set at 770 mm, providing a comfortable riding position for a variety of riders. The scooter has a fuel tank capacity of 6.5 liters, allowing for extended journeys without frequent refueling.
The V125 2026 features a robust braking system with hydraulic disc brakes on both the front and rear wheels, each measuring 220 mm in diameter. This setup is complemented by a Combi Brake System (CBS), which distributes braking force evenly for enhanced safety. The scooter rides on 12-inch alloy wheels fitted with tubeless tires, sized 110/70-12 at the front and 120/70-12 at the rear, offering stability and grip on various road surfaces.
The suspension system comprises telescopic forks at the front and a single suspension at the rear, designed to absorb road imperfections and provide a smooth ride. The V125's frame is constructed from high-quality steel, featuring a double-layer side panel and a central steel beam for added rigidity and durability. This semi-monocoque design not only ensures structural integrity but also allows easy access to the engine for maintenance.
Aesthetically, the V125 pays homage to Lambretta's rich heritage with its classic lines and attention to detail. The scooter is equipped with a full LED lighting system, including headlights and taillights that incorporate the iconic Lambretta logo, enhancing visibility and adding a touch of elegance. The exhaust system is designed with sharp lines and includes heat shields, meeting EURO emission standards and reflecting Lambretta's commitment to environmental responsibility.

The 2026 Lambretta G350 is a stylish scooter that blends classic Italian design with modern technology. It features a 330cc single-cylinder, four-stroke engine that produces approximately 26.4 horsepower at 7,500 rpm and 27 Nm of torque at 6,250 rpm, providing smooth and responsive performance for city commutes and longer rides.
The G350's design pays homage to Lambretta's iconic heritage, showcasing a hexagonal headlight, curved side panels, and a comfortable, elongated seat. The full LED lighting system ensures excellent visibility and adds a modern touch to its vintage-inspired aesthetics.
Riders will appreciate the color TFT display that provides clear, multifunctional information at a glance. For added convenience, a USB charging port is located in the front storage compartment, allowing easy charging of devices on the go.
Safety is a priority with the G350, which comes equipped with a double arm-link front suspension and dual rear shock absorbers for a stable and comfortable ride. The scooter also features disc brakes on both the front and rear wheels, each paired with an advanced ABS system to enhance braking performance and rider confidence.
With a fuel tank capacity of 9.5 liters and a seat height of 790 mm, the Lambretta G350 2026 is designed for practicality and comfort, making it a suitable choice for a variety of riders seeking a blend of classic style and modern functionality.

Description:
The Suzuki e-Access is Suzuki's first electric scooter, unveiled in 2025. It features a 3.07 kWh lithium-iron phosphate battery, providing a claimed range of 95 kilometers on a full charge. The scooter is powered by a 4.1 kW motor, delivering 15 Nm of torque and achieving a top speed of 71 km/h. Charging the e-Access from 0 to 100% takes approximately 6 hours and 42 minutes using a standard portable charger, while a fast charger reduces this time to just 2 hours and 12 minutes.
The scooter offers three riding modes – Eco, Ride A, and Ride B – to suit different riding preferences, and also includes a reverse mode for added convenience. The e-Access is equipped with a fully digital TFT instrument console that supports smartphone connectivity via the Suzuki Ride Connect E-app. This feature enables turn-by-turn navigation and traffic alerts, enhancing the riding experience. Additional features include keyless ignition and an all-LED lighting system.
In terms of design, the e-Access sports a modern and minimalist aesthetic, available in four dual-tone color options: Metallic Mat Black No. 2/Metallic Mat Bordeaux Red, Pearl Grace White/Metallic Mat Fibroin Gray, Pearl Jade Green/Metallic Mat Fibroin Gray, and the newly added Metallic Mat Stellar Blue/Metallic Mat Fibroin Gray. The scooter rides on 12-inch alloy wheels fitted with 90-section tubeless tires at both ends and features a telescopic front fork and a monoshock rear suspension for a comfortable ride. Braking is handled by a front disc brake and a rear drum brake.

The 2026 Yamaha Lander 250 is a rugged and versatile motorcycle designed for both on-road and off-road adventures. The Lander 250 also boasts a fuel-efficient engine and a long-range fuel tank, making it ideal for extended journeys. With its striking design, advanced technology, and impressive performance, the Yamaha Lander 250 is a compelling choice for riders seeking a versatile and capable motorcycle for their next adventure.

Description:
The Hero Xoom 125 2026, launched in 2026, is a stylish and feature-rich scooter from Hero MotoCorp, available in two variants: Xoom 125 ZX and Xoom 125 VX. Priced competitively, it targets young riders and those seeking a sporty yet practical scooter.
The Xoom 125 boasts a sharp and aggressive design, highlighted by its sporty LED headlight, angular side panels, and slim dual-LED tail lights. Its 124.6cc, single-cylinder, air-cooled engine delivers 7.3 kW of power and 10.4 Nm of torque, paired with a CVT transmission for smooth riding.
Equipped with a telescopic fork and monoshock suspension, the Xoom 125 ensures a comfortable ride. The ZX variant features a petal disc brake at the front, while both variants come with drum brakes at the rear.
