Description:
The 2026 Yamaha FZ-S Fi Hybrid is a modern motorcycle that combines advanced technology with practical features. At its heart is a 149cc, single-cylinder, air-cooled engine producing 12.4 horsepower and 13.3 Nm of torque. This engine now complies with OBD-2B standards, ensuring better performance and lower emissions.
One of the standout features is the hybrid system, which includes a Smart Motor Generator (SMG). This system provides battery-assisted acceleration, giving the bike a slight boost during quick maneuvers and making engine starts quieter. Additionally, the Stop and Start System (SSS) automatically turns off the engine when idling and restarts it when the clutch is engaged, helping to save fuel.
The FZ-S Fi Hybrid also boasts a 4.2-inch color TFT display that connects to smartphones via Yamaha’s Y-Connect app. This feature offers turn-by-turn navigation linked to Google Maps and provides SMS and call alerts, enhancing the riding experience.
In terms of design, the motorcycle features integrated front turn signals on the tank extensions, giving it a cohesive look. It is available in two color options: Racing Blue and Cyan Metallic Grey.
For safety, the FZ-S Fi Hybrid comes equipped with a single-channel ABS and a switchable traction control system. The braking setup includes a 282 mm front disc and a 220 mm rear disc. Suspension duties are handled by a conventional telescopic front fork and a preload-adjustable rear monoshock. The motorcycle rides on 17-inch wheels, with 100-section front and 140-section rear tires, providing stability and grip.

The TVS iQube ST 2026 has emerged as a significant player in the rapidly evolving electric scooter market, blending modern design with enhanced performance and smart features. TVS has officially launched the updated iQube S and iQube ST models, building upon the foundation of earlier concepts showcased at events like the Auto Expo. The 2026 iQube ST is available in two variants, primarily differentiated by their battery capacity. The first variant features a 3.5 kWh battery with a range of 145 km and a top speed of 78 km/h. The second, top-tier variant boasts a larger 5.3 kWh battery, extending the IDC range to an impressive 212 km and increasing the top speed to 82 km/h.
Visually, the iQube ST retains a contemporary aesthetic, now enhanced with unique color options like Starlight Blue Grey, Copper Bronze Matte, and Titanium Grey Matte, often complemented by stylish graphics. A notable addition to the design is a neatly integrated pillion backrest, enhancing passenger comfort, along with beige-colored inner panels and a dual-tone seat. The scooter features a sleek LED headlamp with DRLs and a blacked-out windshield.
In terms of features, the 2026 iQube ST comes equipped with a 7-inch touchscreen TFT display that provides crucial information such as speed, range, and battery status. Smartphone connectivity is a key highlight, offering turn-by-turn navigation, call and SMS alerts, and music controls. Additional smart features include geo-fencing, anti-theft alarm, and a customizable display. The scooter also incorporates a front disc brake for effective stopping power and comfortable front suspension. Practicality is further enhanced by a generous 32-liter under-seat storage space and a USB charging port. The iQube ST also features regenerative braking, which helps improve the overall range by converting kinetic energy during deceleration into electrical energy. Charging the 5.3 kWh variant from 0 to 80% takes approximately 4 hours and 18 minutes using the portable charger.

The newly launched 2026 Honda CD 70 builds on the legacy of a motorcycle that has been a staple on the country's roads for decades. It retains its comfortable seating, durable rear wheel with thicker spokes, and a backbone-type frame. Like earlier models, the CD 70's main appeal lies in its proven track record for dependability, easy availability of spare parts, and excellent resale value, making it a popular choice for daily commutes and long-distance travel.

The 2025 CFMoto CFX-2E is an electric mini dirt bike designed for young riders, offering a thrilling and safe introduction to the world of off-road riding. Powered by a 1.5kW brushless electric motor, it delivers smooth and responsive performance, making it ideal for beginners. The 48V, 24Ah lithium-ion battery provides a range of up to 37 miles, ensuring ample ride time for extended adventures. With a five-hour charge time, the battery is also easily removable and swappable, adding convenience to the riding experience.
Designed with safety and adaptability in mind, the CFX-2E features an innovative ride mode system with three speed settings: Learning (15 mph), Standard (22 mph), and Sport (31 mph). This allows parents to tailor the bike's performance to their child's skill level, ensuring a safe and progressive learning curve. The e-throttle is specifically designed for children over six, providing easy operation and control. A magnetic safety lanyard enables quick power disengagement in emergencies, adding an extra layer of safety.
The CFX-2E boasts a robust construction with a cradle steel-tube frame, alloy rims, and full disc brakes, ensuring durability and reliable stopping power. The long-travel suspension, featuring a telescopic front fork and central monoshock rear, is expertly tuned for off-road riding, providing a smooth and comfortable ride over various terrains. With a low seat height of 21.7 inches and a lightweight design at 108 pounds, the CFX-2E offers kid-friendly ergonomics, making it easy for young riders to handle and maneuver.

The standard CG 125 continues with a kick-start and 4-speed transmission, whereas the "S" and "S Gold" variants feature a self-start system and a 5-speed transmission, offering enhanced convenience and a smoother ride. Despite the absence of major mechanical overhauls, the bike remains a top choice for daily commuters due to its proven reliability, fuel efficiency, and strong resale value.

One of the standout features of the S1 Gen 3 is its advanced technology. The scooter comes equipped with a user-friendly touchscreen interface, integrated navigation, and smartphone connectivity, allowing riders to seamlessly control various aspects of their ride. Safety is also a top priority, with features like anti-lock brakes, regenerative braking, and a robust build quality.

The Ola S1 Pro Gen 3 2026 represents a significant leap forward in electric scooter technology, building upon the strengths of its predecessors while introducing a host of innovative features and improvements. At the heart of this evolution lies the Gen 3 platform, which underpins the entire S1 portfolio. This platform boasts a new mid-drive motor with an integrated MCU, resulting in a 4% increase in energy efficiency and a remarkable five-fold improvement in reliability. Ola has also transitioned from belt drives to chain drives across all its models, addressing a common service concern and promising twice the lifespan and enhanced acceleration. Additionally, the Gen 3 platform incorporates a single integrated electronics board, streamlining the system and reducing both weight and cost.
Safety takes center stage with the introduction of Brake-by-Wire technology, featuring a patented brake sensor that intelligently modulates braking force based on rider input and urgency. This not only enhances safety but also reduces brake pad wear and increases energy recovery by 15%. The S1 Pro Gen 3 also offers the option of dual-channel ABS, further bolstering rider safety in various conditions. Performance-wise, the Gen 3 platform delivers a 20% increase in peak power compared to Gen 2, along with an 11% reduction in cost and a 20% increase in range. The flagship S1 Pro+ model, with its 5.3kWh battery, boasts an impressive range of 320 km, making it a true game-changer in the electric scooter segment.
Beyond the hardware upgrades, the Ola S1 Pro Gen 3 2026 also benefits from the latest MoveOS 5 operating system, which unlocks a plethora of smart features and functionalities. These include a smartwatch app, smart park assist, road trip mode powered by Ola Maps, live location sharing, and an emergency SOS feature.

The Ola S1 X is an electric scooter launched on January 31, 2026. It is available in four variants: S1 X (2 kWh), S1 X (3 kWh), S1 X (4 kWh), and S1 X Plus. The base model, S1 X (2 kWh), has a range of 95 km. The S1 X (3 kWh) variant offers a range of 143 km, while the S1 X Plus has a range of 151 km. Additionally, the S1 X Plus features a digital instrument console and Bluetooth connectivity.
The Ola S1 X is powered by a hub motor producing 6 kW of peak power. Its top speed is 85 km/h. For suspension, the scooter has a twin telescopic setup at the front and a dual-shock suspension at the rear. Both the front and rear are equipped with drum brakes.

The Vespa Elettrica 2026 is the latest iteration of Vespa's iconic electric scooter, blending classic Italian design with modern electric technology. It features a sleek, retro-futuristic aesthetic, retaining the signature Vespa silhouette while incorporating contemporary elements like a digital instrument panel and LED lighting. The Elettrica is powered by a quiet yet powerful electric motor, offering brisk acceleration and a smooth ride, ideal for navigating city streets. It boasts an improved battery range compared to previous models, allowing for extended urban commutes on a single charge. The scooter also includes advanced features such as regenerative braking, which helps to recharge the battery during deceleration, and connectivity options via a dedicated app, providing riders with real-time data on battery status, range, and other essential information. Safety features include enhanced braking systems and responsive handling, ensuring a secure and enjoyable riding experience.

The Honda Giorno+ 2026 (also known as the Honda Giorno 125 2026 ) is a stylish and practical scooter perfect for urban commuting. Its retro design draws inspiration from classic Italian scooters of the 1950s and 60s, featuring soft, rounded lines, vibrant colors, and chrome accents.
The liquid-cooled 125cc single-cylinder engine offers brisk performance and economical fuel consumption, ideal for daily city travel. The V-Matic automatic transmission makes riding easy and intuitive, while the Combined Braking System (CBS) ensures safe and controlled braking in any situation.
The Honda Giorno+ 2026 features ample under-seat storage capable of accommodating a full-face helmet, a convenient front storage compartment, and a practical bag hook. The low and spacious seat provides excellent comfort even for taller riders, while the well-tuned suspension ensures a smooth ride even on bumpy roads.
Key features of the Honda Giorno+ 2026 include:
Retro design inspired by classic Italian scooters
Liquid-cooled 125cc single-cylinder engine
V-Matic automatic transmission
Combined Braking System (CBS)
Ample under-seat storage
Front storage compartment
Bag hook
Low and spacious seat
Comfortable suspension
specs: Overall Dimensions (L x W x H)

Description: The 2026 Honda Dax 125 is a retro-styled mini-motorcycle that pays homage to the iconic Honda Dax of the 1970s. It features a classic design with a long, low-slung pressed-steel frame, a high-rise handlebar, and a comfortable seat. The Dax 125 is powered by a reliable and fuel-efficient 124cc air-cooled single-cylinder engine, paired with a four-speed semi-automatic transmission that makes it easy to ride. It also comes standard with features like LED lighting, a digital instrument panel, and front-wheel ABS for added safety. With its charming vintage looks and modern technology, the 2026 Honda Dax 125 is a fun and practical motorcycle for riders of all skill levels.
specs: 236 pounds (Includes all standard equipment, required fluids and a full tank of fuel)

Description:
The Bajaj Freedom 125 CNG 2026 (Bajaj Freedom 125 NG04) is a groundbreaking motorcycle that has made waves in the two-wheeler bike market. As the world's first CNG-powered motorcycle, it represents a significant step towards eco-friendly transportation.
This innovative motorcycle is powered by a 125cc, air-cooled, single-cylinder engine that can run on both CNG and petrol. It offers a unique dual-fuel system, allowing riders to switch between CNG and petrol seamlessly with a simple toggle switch. This feature provides riders with the flexibility to choose the fuel that best suits their needs and availability.
The Freedom 125 CNG boasts impressive fuel efficiency, with a claimed mileage of over 200 km on a full CNG tank and over 130 km on a full petrol tank. This translates to significant cost savings for riders, especially considering the rising prices of petrol. The motorcycle's CNG tank has a capacity of 2 kg, while the petrol tank holds 2 liters.
In terms of features, the Freedom 125 CNG comes equipped with a digital instrument cluster, LED headlights, and a comfortable seat. It also offers a decent amount of storage space, making it a practical choice for daily commuting. The motorcycle's design is similar to other commuter bikes in its segment, with a focus on functionality and comfort.
The Bajaj Freedom 125 CNG is available in three variants: NG04 Drum, NG04 Drum LED, and NG04 Disc LED. With its eco-friendly credentials, cost-effectiveness, and practical features, the Bajaj Freedom 125 CNG is a compelling option for riders looking for a sustainable and economical mode of transportation.

The YADEA i8 is a stylish and practical electric scooter designed with urban commuting in mind. Its retro-inspired aesthetic, characterized by a distinctive front face and rounded LED headlamp, gives it a unique and eye-catching look. The i8 is built for comfort and ease of use, featuring a lightweight frame and a scientifically ergonomic design that caters to riders of all sizes. The seat, handlebar, and pedal height are optimized to ensure a comfortable riding posture, even on longer journeys.
Under the hood, the YADEA i8 boasts a powerful and efficient motor, delivering ample power for navigating city streets and tackling inclines. The advanced battery technology provides a long range on a single charge, minimizing the need for frequent top-ups. The i8 also incorporates smart features such as NFC unlock, allowing riders to start the scooter with a simple tap of their NFC card or smartphone.
Safety is a top priority with the YADEA i8. It is equipped with responsive brakes and a robust suspension system to ensure a smooth and controlled ride. The scooter's bright LED lighting enhances visibility in all conditions, further contributing to rider safety.

The Yadea Starto is a high-capacity urban e-scooter designed for city commuting. It boasts a robust 130kg heavy-duty frame with an innovative dual-tube design for enhanced stability and a distinctive look. The Starto features premium 10-inch vacuum tires for superior shock absorption and a smooth ride, even under heavy loads. It's powered by a 750W peak power motor, delivering consistent performance across various terrains, and an automotive-grade lithium battery providing a 30km range.
For safety, the Starto includes a dual braking system with front drum brakes and rear electronic brakes, along with a 360° lighting system. It also has an IPX5 rating for all-weather protection. The scooter is equipped with smart features like app-enabled connectivity, allowing for proximity unlock, parking lock, Bluetooth alerts, and more. It also has a smart display for key information at a glance. The Starto's 3-second folding design makes it convenient for storage and transport.
specs: Overvoltage Protection, Undervoltage Protection, Short Circuit Protection, Overcurrent Protection, Overheating Protection
Front Drum Brake + Rear Electronic Brake

Description: The 2027 Yamaha Raptor 700R remains a dominant force in the sport ATV world, blending a potent engine with a chassis designed for aggressive riding. Its 686cc, liquid-cooled, SOHC, 4-stroke engine delivers a thrilling combination of low-end grunt and top-end power, making it a blast to ride on any terrain. The Yamaha Fuel Injection (YFI) system ensures crisp throttle response and consistent performance across varying conditions, while the smooth-shifting 5-speed transmission with reverse allows riders to tackle challenging trails with confidence. The Raptor 700R's lightweight hybrid steel-aluminum frame and cast aluminum swingarm provide a solid foundation for its responsive handling. Its fully adjustable suspension, featuring independent double wishbone front suspension and a piggyback shock in the rear, soaks up bumps and ruts with ease, keeping the rider comfortable and in control.
specs: Independent double wishbone and 5-way preload adjustment, 9.1-in travel
Cast aluminum swingarm with preload adjustable shock, 10.1-in travel

Description: The Yamaha GRIZZLY EPS XT-R 2027 is the ultimate ATV for adventurers seeking thrilling off-road experiences. This special edition model combines rugged capability with premium features and aggressive styling, making it a true standout in its class. At its heart lies a potent 686cc engine, delivering ample power and torque to tackle any terrain with confidence. The enhanced Electric Power Steering (EPS) system provides precise handling and reduces rider fatigue, allowing you to conquer challenging trails with ease. The XT-R edition boasts exclusive features such as a factory-installed WARN VRX 25 winch, aluminum wheels, and 27-inch Maxxis 'Zilla tires, ensuring you're ready for any adventure. With its stylish painted bodywork and unique XT-R graphics, this ATV exudes a premium and sporty look. Whether you're exploring remote wilderness areas or tackling tough trails, the Yamaha GRIZZLY EPS XT-R 2027 is the perfect companion for those who demand the best in performance, features, and style.
specs: Ultramatic V-belt with all-wheel engine braking; H, L, N, R, P
Independent double wishbone; 5-way preload adjustment, 7.6-in travel
Independent double wishbone with anti-sway bar; 5-way preload adjustment, 9.1-in travel

Description: The Yamaha Raptor 110 returns for 2027 as the perfect entry-level sport ATV for young riders. This nimble machine boasts a new fuel-injected 112cc air-cooled SOHC 4-stroke engine, tuned to deliver smooth and responsive power ideal for building confidence and skills. The fully automatic CVT transmission eliminates the need for manual shifting, making it easy for beginners to get going, while the addition of reverse gear enhances maneuverability in tight situations. The Raptor 110's sporty styling takes cues from its bigger brother, the legendary Raptor 700R, with aggressive lines and a vibrant color scheme that appeals to younger riders. Its compact A-arm front suspension and preload-adjustable shocks provide a comfortable and controlled ride, while the lightweight wheels and Duro low-profile tires contribute to sharp handling. Safety is a priority, with features like a throttle limiter and a tethered engine cut-off switch allowing parents to maintain control.

The 2027 Yamaha YFZ450R is a high-performance sport ATV designed for experienced riders and racers. It boasts a powerful 449cc, fuel-injected, liquid-cooled engine with a five-valve cylinder head and titanium valves, delivering strong power across the RPM range. The engine is paired with a close-ratio 5-speed transmission and an assist-and-slipper clutch for smooth shifting and reduced engine braking. The YFZ450R features a lightweight hybrid frame combining aluminum and steel for optimal strength and rigidity. Its wide track and long-travel suspension, featuring KYB piggyback shocks, provide excellent handling and stability on the track or trails. The aggressive bodywork offers a comfortable rider position and easy access for maintenance. With its race-ready features and performance, the 2027 Yamaha YFZ450R is a top contender in the sport ATV segment.
specs: Independent double wishbone w/Kashima coated piggyback shocks; high/low speed compression, rebound and threaded preload adjustment, 9.8-in travel
Cast aluminum swingarm w/piggyback shock; high/low speed compression, rebound and threaded preload adjustment, 11.0-in travel

Features: Digital instrument panel; Large-diameter steel cargo racks; Heavy-duty tires; Warn winch
Description:
The Yamaha Kodiak 450 has long been a favorite among utility ATV enthusiasts, and the 2027 model is no exception. This mid-sized machine offers a compelling blend of capability, comfort, and value, making it an excellent choice for both work and play.
Performance and Handling
At the heart of the Kodiak 450 lies a reliable 421cc single-cylinder, liquid-cooled engine. This powerplant delivers smooth, predictable power that's well-suited for a variety of tasks, from tackling tough trails to hauling heavy loads. Yamaha's Ultramatic automatic transmission ensures smooth shifts and excellent engine braking, while the On-Command 2WD/4WD system allows riders to easily switch between two-wheel and four-wheel drive as needed.
The Kodiak 450's compact chassis and independent suspension provide a comfortable and controlled ride, even on rough terrain. With nearly 10 inches of ground clearance, this ATV can confidently navigate obstacles, while its precise handling makes it easy to maneuver through tight spaces.
Features and Versatility
The 2027 Kodiak 450 comes standard with a range of features designed to enhance its versatility and practicality. These include:
Digital instrument panel: Provides clear and concise information on speed, fuel level, and other vital stats.
Large-diameter steel cargo racks: Offer ample space for carrying gear and equipment.
Heavy-duty tires: Provide excellent traction and durability in a variety of conditions.
Warn winch: A pre-installed Warn winch adds to the Kodiak 450's versatility, making it easy to get out of sticky situations or tackle challenging tasks.
specs: Ultramatic V-belt with all-wheel engine braking; H, L, N, R, P

Description: The Yamaha Kodiak 700 2027 is a utility ATV designed for both work and recreational riding. It features a powerful 686cc engine, Yamaha's Ultramatic transmission, and On-Command 4WD system, making it capable of handling tough terrain and heavy workloads. The Kodiak 700 also boasts a comfortable ride thanks to its independent double wishbone suspension and electronic power steering. It has a payload capacity of over 300 pounds and a towing capacity of over 1,300 pounds, making it a versatile machine for various tasks.
specs: Ultramatic V-belt with all-wheel engine braking; H, L, N, R, P
Independent double wishbone with anti-sway bar, 9.1-in travel

Description:
The 2026 Kawasaki Versys 1100 is a top-tier adventure sport-touring motorcycle designed for riders who crave both thrilling performance and long-distance comfort. It boasts a newly enhanced 1,099cc liquid-cooled inline-four engine, delivering a significant boost in power and torque compared to its predecessor. This translates to exhilarating acceleration and effortless cruising, whether navigating city streets or exploring winding mountain roads.
The Versys 1100 comes equipped with a comprehensive suite of electronic rider aids, including Kawasaki Electronic Control Suspension (KECS) with Showa's Skyhook technology. This dynamically adjusts the suspension for optimal ride quality and handling. Additionally, it features multiple power modes, traction control, cruise control, and a quickshifter. This allows riders to tailor the bike's performance to their preferences and riding conditions.
For long journeys, the Versys 1100 offers exceptional comfort and practicality. Its spacious riding position, adjustable windscreen, and comfortable seat ensure a fatigue-free experience, even on extended rides. The bike comes standard with two 28-liter saddlebags, providing ample storage for gear. Other touring-friendly features include heated grips, hand guards, and a USB-C outlet for charging devices.

Description: The QJ Motor SRK 800 RR 2026 is a middleweight sportbike that has been making waves in the motorcycle world. It is powered by a liquid-cooled 778 cc inline-four engine that produces 95 hp at 10000 rpm and 78 Nm of torque at 8,500 rpm. The engine is mated to a six-speed gearbox and a chain final drive. The SRK 800 RR has a number of features that make it a competitive sportbike, including an aluminum twin-spar frame, adjustable Marzocchi forks, Brembo brakes, and a 5-inch TFT color display. The bike also has a number of aerodynamic features, such as winglets and a compact exhaust tailpipe. The SRK 800 RR is available in two colors: red and sea salt white.
specs: 95 hp (70 kW) at 10000 rpm (Bridable A2 - 47 hp)
Marzocchi separate canister adjustable rear shock absorber
Brembo master cylinder and radial calipers / Double disc Ø 320 mm (ABS)

Description: The QJ Motor SRK 125 R 2026 is a sporty and agile motorcycle designed for young riders and those looking for an exciting entry-level sportbike. It boasts a liquid-cooled, single-cylinder engine that delivers a punchy performance, making it fun to ride both in the city and on twisty roads. The SRK 125 R features a sharp and aggressive styling, with sleek lines and a modern design that sets it apart in its class. It comes equipped with features such as LED lighting, a digital instrument panel, and a comfortable riding position, enhancing the overall riding experience. The bike's lightweight chassis and responsive handling make it easy to maneuver, while the reliable braking system provides confident stopping power.

The QJ Motor SRK 700 2026 is a compelling middleweight naked bike that has been making waves in the motorcycle world. It boasts a punchy 698cc parallel-twin engine that delivers a healthy 73.4 horsepower and 67 Nm of torque, making it a thrilling ride for both daily commutes and weekend adventures. The SRK 700's design is modern and aggressive, with sharp lines and a sporty stance that give it a distinct road presence. Its compact chassis and well-tuned suspension provide agile handling and confident cornering, while the comfortable riding position makes it suitable for longer journeys.
One of the standout features of the SRK 700 is its impressive list of standard equipment, which includes features like a full-color TFT instrument panel, LED lighting, and ABS. These features are often found on more expensive motorcycles, making the SRK 700 a great value proposition. QJ Motor has also focused on safety, equipping the SRK 700 with reliable brakes and responsive suspension to ensure a secure and controlled ride.
specs: 67.0 Nm at 6000 rpm (A2: 58.0 Nm at 5250 rpm)

Description:
The QJ Motor SRK 550 2026 is a compelling middleweight naked bike that blends sporty performance with everyday usability. Its 554cc parallel-twin engine delivers a punchy 61 horsepower and 55 Nm of torque, making it a thrilling ride on both city streets and winding roads. The SRK 550 boasts a well-balanced chassis, featuring Marzocchi inverted front forks and a responsive rear suspension, providing confident handling and a comfortable ride. Its lightweight design further enhances agility and maneuverability, making it a joy to flick through corners.
In terms of features, the SRK 550 comes equipped with modern amenities such as a digital instrument panel, LED lighting all around, and a convenient USB charging port. Safety is also prioritized with dual-channel ABS for reliable braking performance. The bike's styling is contemporary and aggressive, with sharp lines and a muscular stance that give it a distinct road presence.
specs: Brembo radial calipers / Double disc Ø 320 mm

Description: The QJ Motor SRK 400 is a naked streetfighter motorcycle that has been making waves in the two-wheeler market. It is powered by a 400cc, parallel-twin, liquid-cooled engine that produces a maximum power of 41 bhp at 9,000 rpm and a peak torque of 37 Nm at 7,500 rpm. The engine is mated to a 6-speed gearbox and is known for its smooth and refined performance. The SRK 400 has an aggressive and sporty design, with a sharp headlight, a muscular fuel tank, and a sleek tail section. It features a digital instrument console, LED lighting, and a comfortable riding position. The bike rides on 17-inch alloy wheels and has telescopic forks at the front and a monoshock at the rear. The braking duties are handled by dual disc brakes at the front and a single disc brake at the rear, with dual-channel ABS as standard.

The QJ Motor SRT 800 SX 2026 is a flagship adventure motorcycle that boasts a powerful 799cc parallel-twin engine, producing 92.5 horsepower and 77 Nm of torque. This engine, combined with a 24-liter fuel tank, promises an extensive range, ideal for long journeys. The SRT 800 SX also features high-quality components such as Brembo brakes with ABS, Marzocchi suspension, and a 7-inch TFT screen with smartphone connectivity. Its design is both modern and functional, with a focus on rider comfort and practicality.
While the SRT 800 SX is the top-of-the-line model, QJ Motor also offers the SRT 700 X and SRT 550 SX. The SRT 700 X is a mid-range adventure bike with a 693cc engine, offering a balance of performance and affordability. The SRT 550 SX is an entry-level model designed for riders who are new to adventure touring. All three models share a similar design language and offer a range of features suitable for different riding needs and budgets.
specs: 92.5 hp at 9000 rpm (A2: 47 hp at 6500 rpm)
77 Nm at 8000 rpm 58 Nm at 5250 rpm
Brembo radial calipers - Double disc Ø 320 mm (ABS)

Description:
The QJ Motor SRV 600 V4 2026 is a cruiser motorcycle released in 2026. It is powered by a 561cc V4 engine that produces 68 horsepower and 54 Nm of torque. The engine is mated to a 6-speed gearbox. The bike has a number of features that make it a good choice for riders who are looking for a comfortable and stylish cruiser. These features include a low seat height, a comfortable riding position, and a number of chrome accents. The bike is also available with a number of optional features, such as ABS brakes and a windshield.
The QJ Motor SRV 600 V4 is a good choice for riders who are looking for a cruiser motorcycle that is both stylish and affordable. The bike is also a good choice for riders who are looking for a bike that is comfortable to ride.

The QJ Motor SRV 550 for 2026 is a cruiser-style motorcycle that blends classic aesthetics with modern performance. It is powered by a 554cc parallel-twin engine, delivering a balance of power and fuel efficiency suitable for both city riding and longer journeys. The SRV 550 features a comfortable riding position, a low seat height, and a relaxed handlebar setup, making it accessible to a wide range of riders. Its design incorporates elements reminiscent of traditional cruisers, such as a teardrop-shaped fuel tank, chrome accents, and a wide rear tire, while also incorporating contemporary touches like LED lighting and a digital instrument panel.

The QJ Motor SRV 125 is a cruiser-style motorcycle that offers a blend of classic aesthetics and modern technology. It's powered by a 125cc, Euro 5+-compliant, four-stroke engine that delivers 11 kW (15 hp) and 12.1 Nm of torque. This engine is paired with a 6-speed gearbox and electronic fuel injection for smooth power delivery and good fuel economy. The SRV 125 features a classic cruiser design with a teardrop-shaped fuel tank, a low-slung seat, and a chrome exhaust system. It also has modern touches such as LED lighting, a digital instrument panel, and ABS brakes. The bike rides on a 17-inch front wheel and a 15-inch rear wheel, and it has a comfortable riding position that's suitable for both commuting and longer rides.
specs: Hydraulic shock absorbers with separate cylinder

Description:
The QJ Motor LTR 125 2026 is a stylish and practical scooter that blends classic design with modern features. It's powered by a 125cc, 4-valve, liquid-cooled single-cylinder engine that delivers a punchy 14 horsepower, making it ideal for navigating city streets and urban commutes. A standout feature of the LTR 125 is its retro-inspired aesthetic, which includes a round headlight, chrome accents, and a vintage-style seat. This gives it a distinct and appealing look that sets it apart from more contemporary scooters.
Despite its classic styling, the LTR 125 is packed with modern technology. It boasts a digital LCD instrument panel, full LED lighting for enhanced visibility, and a convenient keyless start system. For added safety, it's equipped with dual-channel ABS, ensuring confident braking in various conditions. Practicality is also a key consideration, with a spacious under-seat storage compartment capable of holding a helmet, and a standard top case for additional cargo capacity.

The QJ Motor ATR 125 is a feature-rich and stylish scooter designed for both daily commuting and light adventure. Its aggressive styling, comfortable ergonomics, and advanced technology make it stand out in the 125cc scooter segment.
Performance and Technology
At the heart of the ATR 125 is a liquid-cooled, 125cc single-cylinder engine that delivers a punchy performance. It boasts a hybrid boost system for improved fuel efficiency and comes equipped with features like traction control, keyless ignition, start & stop, and ABS for enhanced safety and convenience.
Design and Comfort
The ATR 125's design is characterized by its sharp lines and a commanding presence. It offers ample legroom and a spacious seat for both the rider and passenger, ensuring a comfortable ride even on longer journeys.
Safety and Features
Safety is a priority on the ATR 125, with disc brakes at the front and rear, coupled with ABS for confident braking in all conditions. The inclusion of traction control further enhances stability and rider confidence.
specs: Double hydraulic shock absorber with separate cylinder

Description:
The Honda NX200 for 2026 has been officially launched, replacing the CB200X in Honda's lineup. This adventure motorcycle carries a similar design language to its predecessor but comes with a host of updates. It features a semi-faired design with a sharp LED headlamp, an upright windscreen, and knuckle guards, giving it a sporty and imposing stance. The NX200 is powered by an OBD2B-compliant 184.4cc, single-cylinder engine, delivering 16.7 BHP at 8,500 rpm and 15.7 Nm at 6,000 rpm, paired with a 5-speed gearbox via an Assist & Slipper Clutch.
The bike rides on 17-inch alloy wheels with disc brakes at both ends and dual-channel ABS for safety. Suspension duties are handled by upside-down forks at the front and a mono-shock at the rear. A significant upgrade is the new 4.2-inch digital instrument console with Bluetooth connectivity, navigation, call and SMS alerts, and a USB Type-C charging port. It is also compatible with the Honda RoadSync app. With these updates, the NX200 aims to offer a blend of style, features, and performance in the entry-level adventure segment.

Features: Engine and Performance; Practicality and Convenience; Availability and Pricing
Description:
The Kawasaki Brusky 125 enters the scooter market for the 2026 model year, blending practicality, style, and affordability. This scooter, a rebadged version of Malaysia's Modenas Karisma 125, represents Kawasaki's renewed focus on the scooter segment, particularly in markets where these urban commuters are highly popular.
Design and Features:
The Brusky 125 2026 sports a contemporary design with sharp lines and an overall aesthetic that appeals to a younger demographic. It features an all-LED lighting system, enhancing visibility and adding a modern touch. The semi-digital instrument panel provides essential information at a glance, including a digital fuel gauge. A convenient USB charging port allows riders to keep their devices powered up on the go.
Engine and Performance:
At the heart of the Brusky 125 is a 125cc, air-cooled, fuel-injected engine paired with a Continuously Variable Transmission (CVT). This combination promises a smooth and efficient ride, ideal for navigating city streets and daily commutes. The engine is tuned to deliver a balance of performance and fuel economy, catering to the needs of practical riders.
Practicality and Convenience:
The Kawasaki Brusky 2026 offers a 14-liter under-seat storage compartment, providing ample space for personal belongings or small grocery runs. The 5.1-liter fuel tank ensures a decent range for daily commutes. Additional practical features include an easy-to-operate seat opening switch and a reliable braking system with a front disc brake.
Availability and Pricing:
The Kawasaki Brusky 125 is offered at a competitive price point, making it an attractive option for budget-conscious buyers. It is available in a variety of colors, allowing riders to choose one that suits their personal style.
specs: 4stroke, SOHC single cylinder 2 valve, Fuel Injection

Description:
The 2026 Aprilia Shiver 900 is a powerful and stylish motorcycle, especially designed for riders who enjoy a thrilling experience. It is equipped with an 896cc V-twin engine that produces about 93 horsepower and 66 pound-feet of torque, providing strong and responsive performance.
This model includes modern features to enhance the riding experience. It offers three riding modes—Sport, Touring, and Rain—allowing riders to adjust the bike's behavior to different conditions. Additionally, it has a three-level traction control system and dual-channel ABS for improved safety and control. The bike also comes with all-LED lighting, backlit switchgear, and a clear TFT instrument cluster that automatically switches between day and night modes for easy visibility.
The Shiver 900's frame combines steel and aluminum parts, creating a strong yet lightweight structure. The suspension system includes adjustable upside-down front forks and a rear monoshock, ensuring a comfortable ride over various road surfaces. For braking, the bike uses dual 320 mm front discs and a single 240 mm rear disc, providing reliable stopping power.
In terms of design, the Shiver 900 maintains its sleek and aggressive look, with a comfortable seat height of 810 mm, making it accessible to many riders. The fuel tank holds 12 liters, offering a reasonable range for both city commuting and longer trips.

Description: The 2026 Honda NT1100 represents a significant step forward in the evolution of Honda's sport-touring platform. Building upon the strengths of its predecessor, the 2026 NT1100 incorporates a range of updates and refinements that enhance its performance, comfort, and versatility. At the heart of this updated machine lies a revised 1,084cc parallel-twin engine, now boasting increased low-to-midrange torque and smoother throttle response, making it even more effortless to carve through twisty roads or cruise along scenic highways. The addition of a six-axis Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) allows for more sophisticated rider aids, including refined traction control, wheelie control, and cornering ABS, providing riders with enhanced confidence and control in various riding conditions. The optional Dual Clutch Transmission (DCT) continues to be a standout feature, offering seamless gear changes and an engaging riding experience. For 2026, the DCT has been further refined for smoother operation at low speeds and improved responsiveness. The chassis also receives notable upgrades, with the introduction of electronically adjustable Showa suspension, allowing riders to fine-tune the bike's handling characteristics to suit their preferences and riding style. The updated styling gives the NT1100 a more modern and dynamic appearance, while practical features such as the adjustable windscreen, spacious panniers, and comfortable ergonomics ensure that it remains a capable and comfortable long-distance tourer.

Description:
The Honda Stylo 160 2026 is an exciting new addition to Honda's scooter lineup, blending a stylish retro-modern design with cutting-edge technology and performance. Inspired by classic European and vintage scooter aesthetics, the Stylo 160 stands out with its elegant curves, smooth body lines, and premium detailing, making it an attractive choice for urban riders who value both form and function.
Underneath its stylish exterior, the Stylo 160 is powered by a 156.9cc, liquid-cooled, single-cylinder engine, delivering a refined balance of power, fuel efficiency, and low emissions. This engine is designed to provide smooth acceleration and responsive performance, making city commuting effortless while also ensuring a comfortable ride on longer journeys.
Honda has equipped the Stylo 160 with advanced features such as a fully digital instrument cluster, smart key system with keyless ignition, and LED lighting for improved visibility. Additionally, the scooter comes with Honda Selectable Torque Control (HSTC), ensuring better grip and stability on slippery roads. A front disc brake and rear drum brake further enhance rider confidence by providing precise braking control.
Built on a lightweight yet durable frame, the Stylo 160 offers a comfortable riding posture, spacious footboard, and a well-padded seat, making it an excellent choice for daily riders. With a generous under-seat storage compartment, USB charging port, and a fuel-efficient engine, the Stylo 160 is designed to meet the needs of modern urban commuters who demand both practicality and style.
specs: Single Cylinder, 4-Stroke, Liquid Cooled, SOHC Engine

Description: The Yamaha Fino 125 for 2026 is a stylish and practical scooter that blends retro-inspired design with modern features and technology. It's powered by a reliable 125cc, air-cooled, 4-stroke engine with Yamaha's Blue Core technology, which optimizes fuel efficiency and performance. This makes the Fino 125 an ideal choice for daily commutes and city riding, offering a balance of power and economy. The Fino 125 boasts a comfortable riding position, thanks to its well-designed seat and handlebars, and its lightweight construction makes it easy to maneuver through traffic. It also features a spacious under-seat storage compartment, perfect for carrying personal belongings or shopping bags. For 2026, the Fino 125 comes with several enhancements, including a refreshed color palette and updated graphics that accentuate its retro charm. It also gets a new LED headlight for improved visibility and a digital instrument panel that provides clear and concise information to the rider. Other notable features include a keyless start system, a USB charging port, and a combined braking system for enhanced safety. The Yamaha Fino 125 is available in different variants, each with its own unique styling and features, catering to a wide range of riders.

Triumph Motorcycles has launched the updated Speed T4 for 2027. The Speed T4 is the more affordable version of the Speed 400, and it is powered by the same 398cc, liquid-cooled, single-cylinder engine. The engine has been re-tuned for better low-end torque and tractability, and it produces 31PS at 7000rpm and 36Nm at 5000rpm. The Speed T4 is a great option for riders who are looking for a stylish and affordable motorcycle. It is also a good choice for riders who are new to motorcycling, as it is easy to handle and control. The Speed T4 is available in three colors: Metallic White, Phantom Black, and Cocktail Red Wine.

Description:
The Kawasaki Ninja 300 2027 is a sport motorcycle that has gained a strong reputation for its performance, reliability, and stylish design. Launched as a successor to the Ninja 250R, the Ninja 300 combines aggressive aesthetics with a powerful yet manageable engine, making it an excellent choice for both beginners and experienced riders. It features a 296cc parallel-twin, liquid-cooled engine that delivers an impressive balance of power and fuel efficiency. With a smooth 6-speed gearbox and an assist-and-slipper clutch, the Ninja 300 2027 provides effortless gear shifts, reducing rider fatigue and enhancing the overall riding experience.
One of its standout features is its lightweight chassis and sporty ergonomics, which make handling nimble and precise, whether you're navigating city streets or carving through winding roads. The aerodynamic fairings not only add to the bike's aggressive look but also help improve stability at high speeds. Additionally, the dual-channel ABS ensures superior braking performance, providing confidence and safety in various riding conditions.
The instrument cluster offers a mix of analog and digital displays, keeping riders informed with essential data such as speed, RPM, fuel level, and trip information. Despite being a smaller displacement bike compared to larger supersport motorcycles, the Ninja 300 holds its own with an exhilarating ride quality, capable of reaching speeds above 170 km/h while maintaining excellent fuel efficiency.
It remains one of the most popular choices for riders looking for a sporty yet practical motorcycle that delivers a thrilling experience without compromising comfort and usability.

Bottom-Link Uni-Trak with gas-charged shock and 5-way adjustable pre-load / 132 mm

Description: The Yamaha Janus 2026 is a stylish and practical scooter designed with the modern rider in mind. It boasts a sleek, contemporary design with a focus on both aesthetics and functionality. The Janus 2026 is powered by Yamaha's reliable and fuel-efficient Blue Core engine, ensuring a smooth and economical ride. It features a comfortable riding position, ample storage space, and modern amenities such as a digital instrument panel and LED lighting. The Janus 2026 is available in a variety of colors and trims, allowing riders to choose a model that best suits their personal style. With its combination of style, performance, and practicality, the Yamaha Janus 2026 is an excellent choice for urban commuting and everyday riding.
specs: Wider (+20 mm compared to previous version)

Description: The 2026 Yamaha Lexi 155 is a popular scooter known for its blend of style, performance, and practicality. It boasts a modern and sporty design, making it a head-turner on the streets. Powering the Lexi 155 is a 155cc Blue Core engine with Variable Valve Actuation (VVA) technology, delivering a good balance of power and fuel efficiency. This makes it suitable for both daily commutes and longer rides. The Lexi 155 also offers a comfortable riding experience with its spacious footboard and comfortable seat. It comes equipped with features like a digital instrument panel, LED lighting, and a smart key system, enhancing convenience and modernity. Safety is also prioritized with features like Anti-lock Braking System (ABS) available on certain variants.

Description:
The Yamaha Grande 2026 is a popular scooter model, renowned for its blend of style, practicality, and fuel efficiency. Its modern and elegant design appeals to a wide range of riders. The Grande typically comes equipped with a reliable and efficient engine, often in the 124.9cc class, making it suitable for both city commuting and occasional longer rides. A key highlight of the Grande is its exceptional fuel economy, a major draw for budget-conscious riders.
Depending on the specific trim level, the Yamaha Grande may offer features such as:
A digital instrument panel
Ample storage space
Advanced features like a smart key system or a start-stop system to enhance fuel efficiency
The ride quality is generally comfortable, thanks to a well-tuned suspension system.
specs: Blue Core Hybrid, air-cooled, 4-stroke, 2-valve, single cylinder

Description: The Yamaha FreeGo 2026 is a popular scooter known for its practicality and features. It typically comes with a 124.9cc engine, offering a good balance of fuel efficiency and performance for city commuting. A key highlight of the FreeGo is often its spacious under-seat storage, capable of accommodating a full-face helmet, which is a significant advantage for riders who carry belongings. The FreeGo 125 also usually includes modern features like LED lighting, a digital instrument panel, and sometimes even smartphone connectivity. Depending on the trim level, it might also offer features like a smart key system and a charging port for devices. Comfort is also a consideration, with a comfortable seat and riding position. Safety features generally include disc brakes on the front wheel and a ABS braking system.

The Yamaha Latte 2026 is a stylish and practical scooter designed with urban riders in mind. It boasts a sleek, modern aesthetic with smooth lines and a sophisticated color palette. The Latte 2026 is powered by Yamaha's reliable Blue Core 124.9cc engine, known for its fuel efficiency and smooth performance, making it an ideal choice for daily commutes. It features a comfortable riding position, ample storage space, and modern amenities like a smart key system and a digital instrument panel. The Yamaha Latte also prioritizes safety with features like a responsive braking system and bright LED lighting.
specs: Blue Core, 2 valve, 4 stroke, SOHC, Forced air cooled

Description:
The Yamaha PG-1 2026, also known as the Yamaha PG 1 2026, is a versatile and stylish motorcycle designed for both urban commuting and off-road adventures. It boasts a classic scrambler-inspired design with a modern touch, making it a head-turner on the streets. The PG-1 is powered by a reliable 113.7cc single-cylinder, air-cooled engine that delivers a balance of performance and fuel efficiency. Its lightweight construction and nimble handling make it easy to maneuver through traffic, while its robust suspension and knobby tires allow it to tackle rough terrain with confidence.
The 2026 model comes with several updates, including a refined engine for improved performance and fuel economy, a redesigned instrument panel with more information, and new color options. It also features upgraded suspension components for a smoother ride and enhanced handling. The Yamaha PG-1 2026 is a practical and fun motorcycle that appeals to a wide range of riders, from daily commuters to weekend adventurers.
specs: Wet type automatic multi disc centrifuge

Description: The Yamaha Neo 2026 electric scooter is a stylish and practical urban mobility solution, designed to offer a smooth, quiet, and efficient ride. It's powered by a hub-mounted electric motor, delivering strong and controllable acceleration with zero emissions. The Neo's features a modern design, with clean lines and a compact body, making it ideal for navigating city streets. It offers a comfortable riding position and easy handling, suitable for riders of all ages and experience levels. The scooter comes with a removable lithium-ion battery, allowing for convenient charging at home or at work. With its combination of performance, style, and eco-friendliness, the Yamaha Neo is a compelling choice for those seeking a smart and sustainable way to commute in urban environments.
specs: 72km with 1 battery (Under constant speed condition of 30km/h; Driver weight is 75kg)

Description:
The Kawasaki Ninja 250 2026 continues the legacy of one of the most popular entry-level sportbikes, offering an exciting blend of performance, style, and reliability. Designed for both beginners and experienced riders looking for a nimble, lightweight machine, the 2026 model refines its aggressive aesthetics while improving overall rideability. Powered by a 249cc parallel-twin engine, the Ninja 250 delivers an optimal balance of power and efficiency, making it perfect for city commuting as well as weekend rides on twisty roads. Kawasaki has fine-tuned the fuel injection system to enhance throttle response, while a revised exhaust system ensures smoother power delivery and a deeper, sportier exhaust note.
Visually, the 2026 Ninja 250 embraces sharp, aerodynamic bodywork inspired by its bigger siblings, the Ninja 400 and ZX series. The LED headlight setup, along with an updated full-digital instrument cluster, gives the bike a modern, high-tech appeal. The lightweight trellis frame improves handling and stability, allowing riders to confidently lean into corners without sacrificing comfort. In terms of suspension, Kawasaki has equipped the new model with telescopic front forks and a preload-adjustable rear monoshock, ensuring a smoother ride over varying road conditions.
For safety, the dual-channel ABS system provides enhanced braking control, especially in wet or slippery conditions, while the wider tires improve grip and stability at higher speeds. Ergonomics remain rider-friendly, with a well-padded seat and a slightly aggressive riding posture that strikes a balance between comfort and sportiness. The 2026 model also introduces smartphone connectivity via Kawasaki’s Rideology app, enabling riders to access essential ride data and notifications directly from their phones.
specs: Uni Trak bottom-link, gas-charged shock with adjustable spring preload
OVERALL DIMENSIONS (L X W X H)

Description:
The Suzuki Skydrive Sport and Skydrive Crossover represent Suzuki's continued commitment to providing practical and stylish scooters for the modern rider in 2026. The Skydrive Sport, with its sleek lines and sporty aesthetic, caters to the younger generation seeking a dynamic and agile ride. It features a fuel-efficient 113cc engine, making it an economical choice for daily commutes and urban adventures. Its lightweight design and responsive handling make navigating through traffic a breeze, while its comfortable seating and ample storage ensure practicality for everyday use. The Skydrive Sport also boasts modern features such as LED lighting, a digital instrument panel, and a convenient USB charging port, keeping riders connected and informed on the go.
On the other hand, the Suzuki Skydrive Crossover takes a different approach, blending the practicality of a scooter with the adventurous spirit of a crossover motorcycle. It sports a more rugged and robust design, with increased ground clearance and a more upright riding position, making it suitable for both paved roads and light off-road trails. The Skydrive Crossover also features a larger displacement engine, providing ample power for tackling inclines and carrying a passenger with ease. Its long-travel suspension and knobby tires further enhance its off-road capabilities, allowing riders to explore beyond the city limits.
specs: SWING-ARM TYPE, coil spring, OIL DAMPED

Description:
The Suzuki GSX-R150 2026 is an exciting addition to the lightweight sportbike category, blending aggressive styling, high-performance engineering, and cutting-edge technology. Designed as a compact yet powerful machine, this bike continues Suzuki's legacy of producing race-inspired motorcycles that deliver thrilling rides both on the track and the street. The 2026 model features a refined 147.3cc liquid-cooled, single-cylinder, DOHC engine, which is tuned for high-revving performance, making it one of the most powerful motorcycles in its segment. With a fuel injection system, the GSX-R150 ensures optimal combustion, superior throttle response, and impressive fuel efficiency, making it suitable for both spirited riding and daily commutes.
One of the standout features of the 2026 Suzuki GSX-R150 is its lightweight trellis frame, which enhances agility and handling, making cornering effortless and providing a stable ride even at high speeds. The bike is equipped with LED headlights and a fully digital instrument cluster, ensuring clear visibility and a modern aesthetic. Additionally, Suzuki has improved rider ergonomics by refining the seating position and adjusting handlebar placement to strike a balance between comfort and sportiness. The advanced braking system, featuring front and rear disc brakes with ABS, adds to the safety and confidence of the rider, allowing for controlled stops even in challenging conditions.
In terms of design, the 2026 GSX-R150 continues to embrace its supersport DNA, inspired by its bigger siblings like the GSX-R1000. The aerodynamic fairings and sleek bodywork not only contribute to its aggressive looks but also enhance performance by reducing drag. Available in multiple color schemes and MotoGP-inspired liveries, the bike appeals to young enthusiasts looking for a stylish yet practical machine. With improved technology such as keyless ignition, a slipper clutch, and Bluetooth connectivity, Suzuki has made sure that the GSX-R150 stays ahead of its competitors in the small-displacement sportbike segment.
specs: US Store CNC Short Brake Clutch

Description:
The Suzuki Satria F150 2026, also known as the Suzuki Raider R150 in some markets, has carved a niche for itself as a lightweight, sporty, and agile underbone motorcycle. Its roots can be traced back to the Suzuki FX125 and FXR150, which were popular for their performance and handling. The Satria F150 carries that legacy forward, offering a thrilling ride experience for both daily commutes and weekend adventures.
At the heart of the Satria F150 lies a 147.3cc, liquid-cooled, DOHC, 4-valve, single-cylinder engine. This punchy motor delivers a healthy dose of power and torque, making it a joy to ride in city traffic and on twisty roads. The engine is mated to a smooth-shifting 6-speed gearbox, allowing riders to extract the most out of its performance.
The Satria F150's lightweight and compact chassis contribute to its nimble handling. It effortlessly carves through corners and feels planted at higher speeds. The telescopic front forks and swingarm rear suspension provide a comfortable and controlled ride, even on bumpy roads. Braking duties are handled by disc brakes at both the front and rear, ensuring confident stopping power.
In terms of styling, the Satria F150 sports a sharp and aggressive design. Its aerodynamic lines, edgy bodywork, and sporty graphics give it a distinctive look that sets it apart from other underbone motorcycles. The digital instrument panel provides all the essential information at a glance, while the LED headlight ensures excellent visibility at night.
specs: US Store CNC Short Brake Clutch

Description:
The Suzuki NEX II 2026 ( Suzuki NEX 2026 ) is a popular scooter model known for its fuel efficiency, practicality, and affordability. It's a lightweight and compact scooter designed for easy maneuverability in urban environments, making it a great choice for daily commutes and navigating through traffic. The Suzuki NEX 2 is powered by a 113cc, single-cylinder, air-cooled engine with Suzuki's Eco Performance (SEP) technology, which optimizes fuel consumption without compromising performance. This makes it an economical option for riders looking to save on fuel costs. The scooter also features a convenient CVT (Continuously Variable Transmission) system, providing smooth and effortless acceleration.
In terms of design, the Suzuki NEX II sports a modern and stylish look with a youthful appeal. It comes in a variety of colors to cater to different preferences. The scooter also offers practical features such as a spacious under-seat storage compartment, a digital instrument panel, and LED lighting for enhanced visibility. Safety features include a front disc brake for reliable stopping power and a side stand interlock for added safety.

The 2026 Suzuki Address 125 is a stylish and practical scooter designed for urban commuting. It boasts a classic European design with attractive lines and chrome accents, giving it a sophisticated look. Under the hood, the Address 125 is powered by Suzuki's Eco Performance (SEP) engine, which delivers a balance of performance and fuel efficiency, achieving an impressive 148 MPG. This makes it an economical choice for daily riders. Beyond its fuel efficiency, the Address 125 offers a comfortable riding position, ample under-seat storage with 21.8 liters of capacity, and a passenger grab bar for added convenience. It's equipped with features like the Suzuki Easy Start System and a standard USB outlet. The Address 125 aims to provide a blend of style, practicality, and affordability for those navigating city streets.

The 2026 Ducati Hypermotard 698 Mono marks a thrilling return to Ducati's supermoto roots, packing a punch in a compact and agile package. This single-cylinder machine is designed to deliver pure riding excitement, whether you're carving up city streets or tearing around a tight, technical track. At its heart lies the new Superquadro Mono, a 659cc engine derived from the Panigale's powerhouse. This makes it the most powerful single-cylinder road-going engine ever produced, boasting an impressive 77.5 hp at 9,750 rpm and 46.5 lb-ft of torque at 8,000 rpm. The desmodromic valve timing, a hallmark of Ducati engines, allows for higher revs and contributes to the engine's exhilarating character.
The Hypermotard 698 Mono's design is pure supermoto, with a high seat, a flat handlebar, and a slim profile that encourages aggressive riding. The bike's lightweight construction and responsive chassis make it incredibly nimble and easy to flick through corners. It's equipped with a comprehensive electronics package, including cornering ABS, traction control, and wheelie control, all of which are adjustable to suit your riding style and conditions. The bike also features a quickshifter for seamless up and down shifts, further enhancing the riding experience.

Description:
The Kawasaki Versys-X 250 2026 is a unique motorcycle in the adventure touring category. It's designed to be a lightweight, nimble, and accessible entry point for riders looking to explore both paved and unpaved roads. Its smaller 249cc parallel-twin engine makes it manageable for newer riders while still providing enough power for comfortable highway cruising and light off-road excursions.
One of the key features of the Versys-X 250 is its long-travel suspension, which soaks up bumps and potholes with ease, making it comfortable on rough roads. The bike also offers a relaxed riding position, further enhancing comfort for long journeys. Its relatively low seat height makes it accessible to a wide range of riders.
specs: Bottom-Link Uni Trak, gas-charged shock with adjustable preload
Fuel injection: ø32 mm x 2 with dual throttle valves

Description: The Kawasaki W230 for 2027 is a retro-styled motorcycle that pays homage to the classic W series, which began with the 1965 650-W1. It is the latest addition to this lineup, joining the W800 in Kawasaki's retro offerings. The W230 is powered by a 233cc air-cooled, single-cylinder engine that delivers a smooth and comfortable ride. The engine is designed to provide ample torque in the low to mid-range, making it ideal for city riding and relaxed cruising. The bike's lightweight chassis and low seat height make it accessible to a wide range of riders, including those who are new to motorcycling or returning to the hobby. The W230's styling is inspired by the classic motorcycles of the past, with a teardrop fuel tank, spoked wheels, and a comfortable, upright riding position.

Features: Engine and Performance; Chassis and Handling
Description:
The Kawasaki D-Tracker 250 ( D-TRACKER X ) for 2026 is a versatile and exciting motorcycle that blends the agility of a supermoto with the practicality of a commuter. It's designed for riders who want a fun and stylish bike for both urban environments and twisty back roads.
Engine and Performance:
The heart of the D-Tracker 250 is a responsive 249cc, single-cylinder, liquid-cooled engine. It delivers a punchy power output that's perfect for navigating city traffic and tackling winding roads with confidence. The engine is known for its smooth power delivery and excellent fuel efficiency, making it an economical choice for daily riding.
Chassis and Handling:
The D-Tracker 250 boasts a lightweight and nimble chassis that makes it incredibly easy to maneuver. Its supermoto-inspired design features 17-inch wheels with wide tires, providing excellent grip and stability on both paved and unpaved surfaces. The suspension is tuned for a balance of comfort and control, allowing riders to confidently carve through corners and soak up bumps in the road.
Styling and Features:
The 2026 D-Tracker 250 showcases a modern and aggressive design with sharp lines and vibrant colors. It features a digital instrument panel that displays essential information such as speed, gear position, and fuel level. The bike also comes with a comfortable seat and a relaxed riding position, making it suitable for longer rides.

Uni Trak, single shock with adjustable compression and rebound damping, and adjustable spring preload

Description:
The Kawasaki KLX150, a popular choice among off-road enthusiasts and beginner riders, continues to impress in its 2026 iteration. This lightweight and agile motorcycle is powered by a reliable 144cc air-cooled, single-cylinder engine, providing a balance of power and controllability suitable for tackling various terrains. Its nimble handling and long-travel suspension make it a joy to ride on trails, while its approachable nature also makes it a great option for those new to off-road motorcycling.
The KLX150 boasts a robust and stylish design, with its sharp lines and aggressive stance giving it a modern and sporty look. It features a comfortable riding position, allowing riders to maintain control and reduce fatigue during longer rides. The bike's lightweight construction further contributes to its ease of handling, making it effortless to maneuver through tight corners and challenging obstacles.
specs: Uni Trak with adjustable spring preload

Features: Blue Core Engine; Adventure Styling; Enhanced Suspension; Modern Technology; Practicality
Description:
The Yamaha X-Ride 125 for 2026 is a versatile and stylish motorcycle designed for both daily commutes and adventurous weekend rides. Its rugged design and features make it a popular choice for riders seeking a blend of practicality and fun.
Key Features:
Blue Core Engine: The 125cc Blue Core engine offers a balance of fuel efficiency and performance, making it ideal for both city and highway riding.
Adventure Styling: The X Ride 125 boasts a distinctive adventure-inspired design with a high-mounted exhaust, rugged tires, and a comfortable riding position.
Enhanced Suspension: The front suspension and sub-tank rear suspension provide a smooth and comfortable ride even on rough roads.
Modern Technology: The motorcycle features modern amenities such as LED headlights, a digital instrument panel, and a keyless start system.
Practicality: The X Ride 125 is designed with practicality in mind, offering ample storage space and a comfortable seat for both rider and passenger.
