Description: The 2026 Vespa S 125 arrives with classic Vespa charm plus subtle updates: it keeps the iconic steel monocoque body and flowing curves of the S-series but adopts new details like a trapezoidal LED headlamp (replacing the old oval lamp) for a sportier look, along with fresh color schemes (including matte dual-tones and a special Oro gold edition) and updated graphics that give it a more modern, premium feel. The cockpit largely stays retro, with an analogue speedometer and fuel gauge flanking a small digital display, but top Tech trims add a 5-inch full-color TFT dashboard (with Bluetooth and turn-by-turn navigation), keyless ignition and a USB charging port for smart connectivity. Comfort is enhanced by a newly shaped, more cushioned seat (with an ergonomic step-up design), a flat floorboard with a recessed footwell, and conveniences like a spacious under-seat trunk (big enough for a half-face helmet) plus a front bag-hook. Under the skin, the S 125 uses a refined 124.45cc single-cylinder 3-valve SOHC engine (air-cooled, fuel-injected) tuned to about 9.3–9.5 bhp at 7,100 rpm and 10.1 Nm of torque (a slight bump over the old model). Mated to a CVT, this delivers smooth city acceleration (about 0–60 km/h in ~8.6 seconds) and a top speed in the mid-80s km/h range, with fuel economy claimed around 45 km/L. The suspension is Vespa’s aircraft-inspired single-sided front fork (with anti-dive geometry) and a four-stage adjustable rear shock, giving a balanced, comfortable ride; safety gear includes a 200mm front disc brake (with a Combined Braking System) and a 140mm rear drum, while bright LED lighting front and rear improves visibility.
specs: Single arm with helical spring and single hydraulic shock absorber
Helical spring with preload adjustable (4 positions) and single hydraulic shock absorber
Sheet steel body with welded reinforcements
Aircraft derived hydraulic single side arm front suspension
Rear suspension with dual-effect hydraulic shock absorber with four piston adjustable
Sheet steel body with welded reinforcements

Description: The 2026 BMW R 1300 RS is powered by a brand-new 1,300 cc air/liquid-cooled boxer twin, known as BMW ShiftCam, that delivers 107 kW (145 hp) at 7,750 rpm and 149 Nm torque at 6,500 rpm. By increasing the bore to 106.5 mm and decreasing the stroke to 73 mm, BMW has boosted output over the outgoing R 1250 RS, which made 100 kW/136 hp and 143 Nm, resulting in the most powerful production BMW boxer engine to date in terms of horsepower. A counterbalancer shaft and modern engine management smooth out vibrations and improve throttle response. Power is sent through a 6-speed gearbox and shaft drive, with an optional Automated Shift Assistant (ASA) offering clutchless upshifts and downshifts. The RS comes equipped with three standard ride modes: Rain, Road, and Eco, with Eco tuned for maximum range, and offers two extra modes, Dynamic and Dynamic Pro, in the Riding Modes Pro package. Traction control (DTC) and Engine Drag Torque Control (MSR) are standard to prevent rear-wheel lift under heavy braking. The fuel capacity is a generous 17 liters, approximately 4.5 gallons, up from about 15 liters on the old model, giving excellent range for touring. The R 1300 RS rides on an all-new chassis with a sheet-steel main frame and die-cast aluminum rear subframe, which is stiffer and more compact than the old tubular frame, allowing BMW to concentrate mass lower and toward the center. The bike has a nearly 54/46% rearward weight bias and a curb weight of approximately 272 kg, with a dry weight of 245 kg. Lighter 17-inch cast-alloy wheels with a hollow-spoke design shave over 1.4 kg off the unsprung weight of the previous RS, improving agility and suspension response. Up front is a new 47 mm inverted fork, and at the rear is an evolved single-sided Paralever swingarm. Electronic Dynamic ESA suspension with automatic damping adjustment is standard, and an optional Dynamic Suspension Adjustment (DSA) package adds automatic spring preload and damping changes tied to riding mode, a BMW first on a telescopic fork. Braking is handled by dual 310 mm floating front discs with four-piston radial calipers and a 285 mm rear disc with a two-piston caliper. BMW’s fully linked ABS Pro is standard, and an optional Sport Brake package with titanium-colored Brembo calipers gives slightly more bite. The new RS features a slim full-LED headlight with separate low/high-beam projectors and distinctive daytime running lights, and for the first time on an RS model, BMW offers the optional adaptive Headlight Pro system with additional LED elements that rotate to light up around corners based on lean angle. The cockpit centers on a 6.5-inch full-color TFT display controlled by a handlebar thumbwheel, and standard comfort and safety kit includes Dynamic Cruise Control with brake-enabled functionality and Bluetooth/USB-C connectivity. The optional Riding Assistant package adds radar-based active cruise control, Front Collision Warning, Lane Change Warning with blind-spot assist, and Rear-End Collision Warning. Despite its sporty intent, the R 1300 RS offers many touring comforts, including a standard rider’s seat height of 790 mm with an option to raise it to 815 mm, and BMW offers four accessory seats, including heated and lower sport versions. The tinted windscreen is two-tone and electrically height-adjustable, and a plush two-person seat and optional passenger grab rails or pillion backrest improve two-up comfort. For luggage, BMW has developed an all-new electrified case system. The new R 1300 RS introduces several BMW-first features, including the optional Dynamic Suspension Adjustment system and the adaptive Headlight Pro, giving the bike a sharper look and better aerodynamics, which boosts the claimed top speed to about 149 mph.
specs: Air/liquid-cooled four-stroke flat twin engine with double overhead and chain driven camshafts and balance gear wheels
Super unleaded (max. 15 % Ethanol, E15), 95 ROZ/RON, 90 AKI; adaptive fuel quality regulation (91-98 ROZ/RON)
Wet clutch, slipper clutch, hydraulically operated

Description:
The newly launched TVS Sport 2026 continues to uphold its reputation as one of the most affordable and fuel-efficient commuter motorcycles. Designed with the daily rider in mind, this model combines practicality, performance, and style, making it an ideal choice for both urban and rural commuters.
At the heart of the TVS Sport 2026 lies a refined 109.7cc, single-cylinder, air-cooled engine that delivers a maximum power of 8.29 PS at 7350 RPM and a peak torque of 8.7 Nm at 4500 RPM. This engine is mated to a 4-speed constant mesh gearbox, ensuring smooth and responsive gear shifts. The integration of TVS's Eco-Thrust Fuel Injection (ETFi) technology optimizes fuel delivery, delivering impressive fuel efficiency of 70-75 kmpl under standard conditions.
The TVS Sport 2026 features updated sharper body panels and new graphics, giving it a more aggressive and modern look. The bike is equipped with LED DRLs, a semi-digital instrument cluster, and a sporty headlamp, enhancing both aesthetics and functionality. The ergonomically designed seat, combined with telescopic front forks and a 5-step adjustable hydraulic rear shock absorber, ensures a comfortable ride even on rough terrains.
Safety has been a focal point in the 2026 model, with the inclusion of Synchronized Braking Technology (SBT) that balances braking forces between the front and rear wheels, reducing the risk of skidding. Additional features like an all-gear electric start, aluminum grab rail, and a long, cushioned seat add to the convenience and comfort for both rider and pillion.
specs: Single Cylinder, 4 Stroke, fuel injection, air cooled spark ignition engine

Description: The 2027 Kawasaki Z1100 has been officially unveiled, marking the return of Kawasaki's big-bore Supernaked to the lineup, offered in both a standard and an SE trim. It embraces the aggressive "Sugomi" design philosophy, featuring sharp lines and a predatory stance. Powering the new machine is a 1,099cc inline-four engine, shared with the Ninja 1100SX, producing a claimed 134-136 horsepower and approximately 83 lb-ft of torque, with internal updates for better low-to-mid-range performance. It sits on an aluminum twin-tube frame and is packed with modern technology, including an Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) that enables cornering management functions, multiple ride modes, an electronic throttle, cruise control, a bi-directional quickshifter, and a new 5-inch TFT display with smartphone connectivity. The higher-spec Z1100 SE elevates the package with premium components like Brembo radial-mount monobloc calipers and an Ohlins S46 rear monoshock with a remote preload adjuster.
specs: Inverted fork with compression and rebound damping, and spring preload adjustability
Horizontal Back-link, Ohlins S46 gas-charged rear shock with rebound damping adjustability and remote spring preload adjustability
Multipoint sequential electronic fuel injection, ride-by-wire
Aluminum twin-spar, bolt-on aluminum rear subframe

Ohlins Smart EC3 semi-active, TTX 36 twin-tube monoshock, fully adjustable; 4.7 in. travel
Brembo Stylema Monoblock calipers, 320mm floating discs w/ OC-ABS adjustable

Description:
The 2026 Ducati Diavel V4 RS marks a significant evolution in the muscle cruiser segment, elevating the Diavel's already formidable presence with a dose of superbike performance. At its heart is the 1,103cc Desmosedici Stradale V4 engine, the same unit found in Ducati's Panigale and Streetfighter V4 models. This powerplant is tuned to produce 182 hp and 89 lb-ft of torque, a notable increase over the standard Diavel V4's V4 Granturismo engine. This performance upgrade, combined with a lighter overall weight achieved through extensive use of carbon fiber and a titanium exhaust, makes the Diavel V4 RS the fastest accelerating production Ducati ever, with a claimed 0-62 mph time of just 2.5 seconds.
Beyond the engine, the Diavel V4 RS is equipped with a host of premium components and electronic aids. It features a dry clutch for a more direct feel and a race-derived sound, along with a full Ohlins suspension setup for enhanced handling. The bike also includes a comprehensive electronics package, featuring multiple riding modes (including a new "Race" mode), cornering ABS, traction control, wheelie control, and Ducati Power Launch (DPL) for explosive acceleration from a standstill. Visually, the Diavel V4 RS is distinguished by its unique carbon fiber bodywork, forged five-spoke wheels, and a numbered plaque on the cylinder head, signifying its exclusivity.

Description:
The newly released Moto Morini X-Cape 1200 marks the brand's ambitious return to the flagship adventure touring segment, blending Italian design flair with a formidable performance profile. At its heart lies the V2 Corsa Corta EVO engine, an 1187cc 87-degree V-twin that delivers a claimed 127 to 129 horsepower and 106 Nm of torque, ensuring a smooth yet punchy delivery across the rev range.
Built for long-distance versatility, the bike features a sophisticated electronics suite including a 7-inch TFT display with integrated navigation, Bosch Cornering ABS, traction control, and a bidirectional quickshifter. To set itself apart in a crowded market, Moto Morini has equipped the X-Cape 1200 with premium hardware like Brembo monoblock calipers, fully adjustable KYB suspension with 180mm of travel, and advanced safety tech such as rear-facing blind-spot radar and a front-mounted recording camera. With its distinct trellis frame and 19-inch front/17-inch rear spoked wheels shod in Pirelli Scorpion Trail III tires, the X-Cape 1200 positions itself as a competitive "maxi-enduro" alternative for riders seeking Italian character at a potentially more accessible price point than its European rivals.
specs: Twin 320 mm discs with monoblock calipers

Description: The TVS Apache RTR 200 4V 2026 is a popular performance-oriented street naked motorcycle known for its blend of aggressive styling, reliable engineering, and features that cater to both daily commuting and spirited riding. It is powered by a 197.75cc single-cylinder, oil-cooled, fuel-injected engine which utilizes a 4-valve head for enhanced breathing and power delivery, often paired with a smooth 5-speed gearbox and a slipper clutch for easy downshifts. The bike stands out with its race-derived credentials, including the company's 'Race-Tuned' (RT) Fuel Injection system, multiple riding modes (Sport, Urban, and Rain), and adjustable suspension, making it a well-rounded and technologically advanced offering in the highly competitive 200cc segment.
specs: 20.82 PS @ 9000 rpm, Urban/ Rain: 17.32 PS @ 7800 rpm
17.25 Nm @ 7250 rpm, Urban/ Rain: 16.51 Nm @ 5750 rpm

Description: The QJ Motor SRT 300 DX 2026 is the latest addition to the adventure-touring segment, offering a refined blend of performance, practicality, and style. Designed for riders who seek versatility on both city roads and open highways, the SRT 300 DX features a 292.3cc twin-cylinder engine that delivers smooth power and commendable fuel efficiency. With its upright riding posture, long-travel suspension, and dual-purpose tires, the bike is well-suited for light off-road excursions as well. Modern features like a digital instrument cluster, LED lighting, and ABS enhance both safety and convenience, while the bold design and rugged stance give it a premium feel. The 2026 update brings subtle refinements in ergonomics and electronics, reinforcing the SRT 300 DX as a solid choice for entry-level adventure enthusiasts.

The TVS Orbiter 2026 is a new electric scooter launched by TVS Motor Company in 2026, positioned as a competitive and family-friendly option in the growing EV market. It is powered by a 3.1 kWh battery, providing a claimed IDC range of 158 km on a single charge. The Orbiter is designed for practical, urban commuting with a focus on comfort and convenience, featuring an 845mm long flat seat, a straight-line footboard, and a large 34-litre under-seat storage that can hold two helmets.
The scooter is equipped with a host of modern features, including a connected smartphone app with turn-by-turn navigation, geo-fencing, and anti-theft alerts. Other notable features include cruise control, hill hold assist, reverse mode, and a colored LCD instrument cluster that displays call and message notifications. For enhanced stability and ride comfort, it comes with a 14-inch front wheel.

specs: Multipoint sequential electronic fuel injection with electronic throttle control

Description:
Suzuki has recently expanded its 2026 lineup with the introduction of the all-new GSX-8T, a middleweight street bike that masterfully blends retro-inspired aesthetics with modern performance and technology. At its core, the GSX-8T is powered by Suzuki's proven 776cc liquid-cooled parallel-twin DOHC engine, known for its strong torque delivery and flexible power across the rev range. This engine, shared with the successful GSX-8S and GSX-8R, features a 270-degree crankshaft for a V-twin-like feel and smooth operation, further enhanced by Suzuki's Cross Balancer. The "Retro Spirit, Next Generation Performance" philosophy is evident in design elements like the flat-bottom mono-round LED headlight, inspired by Suzuki models of the 1960s and 70s, and the bike's unique handlebar-end mirrors—a first for a modern Suzuki motorcycle.
Beyond its striking looks, the GSX-8T is equipped with a comprehensive Suzuki Intelligent Ride System (S.I.R.S.) suite, including Suzuki Drive Mode Selector (SDMS) with three power output characteristics, a three-mode (plus OFF) Traction Control System, a Bi-directional Quick Shift System for clutchless up/down shifts, Suzuki Easy Start System, and Low RPM Assist. The chassis features a steel frame, KYB inverted front forks, and a preload-adjustable link-type KYB rear mono-shock, promising agile handling and stable performance. Braking is handled by dual radial-mounted Nissin calipers gripping 310mm discs upfront, and the bike rides on 17-inch cast aluminum wheels wrapped in Dunlop SPORTMAX Roadsport 2 tires. Practical features like a 16.5-liter fuel tank, a comfortable "tuck-and-roll" style seat, a 5-inch color TFT LCD instrument panel, and a USB Type-C power slot further enhance its appeal as a versatile and rider-friendly machine for both daily commutes and spirited weekend rides.

Description: The Aprilia SR 125 2026 continues to blend sporty styling with everyday practicality, making it a strong contender in the premium scooter segment. Powered by a refined 124.45cc single-cylinder, air-cooled engine, the SR 125 delivers peppy performance with improved fuel efficiency and smoother throttle response, thanks to BS6 Phase 2 compliance. It features telescopic front forks, a rear monoshock, and 14-inch alloy wheels for confident handling. The scooter gets a semi-digital instrument cluster, LED headlamp, and a redesigned front apron that adds to its aggressive look. With CBS (Combi Braking System) for enhanced safety and a comfortable riding posture, the SR 125 2026 offers a sporty yet practical urban commuting experience.
specs: Hydraulic Shock absorber with five position adjustable

Description:
The 2026 Aprilia SR 175, launched in 2026, represents a significant upgrade over its predecessor, the SR 160. It's powered by a newly developed 174.7 cc, air-cooled, 3-valve single-cylinder engine producing around 13.08 bhp at 7,200 rpm and 14.14 Nm of torque at 6,000 rpm, marking a noticeable boost over the 11-12 bhp output of the SR 160. The engine is mated to a smooth CVT automatic transmission and delivers a top speed of approximately 95 km/h.
On the tech front, the SR 175 debuts a sharp 5.5-inch color TFT instrument cluster—borrowed from Aprilia's RS and Tuono 457 motorcycles—with Bluetooth connectivity for call alerts, music controls, and turn-by-turn navigation. It retains practical features like LED lighting, a USB charging port, a 220 mm front disc brake, a rear drum brake, and single-channel ABS, all riding on 14-inch alloy wheels with 120-section tires, and a suspension setup combining telescopic front forks and a rear monoshock.

The newly released Keeway RR300 2026 marks a bold entry into the quarter-liter sportbike segment with a striking blend of performance and aggressive styling. Powered by a 292.4cc single-cylinder, liquid-cooled engine, the RR300 delivers around 27.5 hp and 25 Nm of torque, offering spirited acceleration for city rides and weekend twisties alike. Its sharp full-fairing design, twin LED headlamps, muscular fuel tank, and split-seat setup give it an unmistakably sporty appeal. The bike features upside-down front forks, a rear mono-shock, front and rear disc brakes with dual-channel ABS, and a fully digital instrument cluster. Lightweight and nimble, the Keeway RR300 2026 caters to young riders looking for a stylish yet practical sports machine with everyday usability and a competitive price point.

Honda has recently unveiled the new CB125 Hornet 2027, marking a significant addition to its 125cc premium commuter lineup. This model is designed to appeal to younger buyers with its advanced styling and segment-first features. Key highlights include golden USD (Upside Down) front forks and an impressive 0-60 km/h acceleration time of just 5.4 seconds, making it a strong contender in its class.
The CB125 Hornet 2027 boasts an all-LED lighting setup, including a distinctive twin-LED headlamp with LED DRLs. It features a muscular fuel tank with sharp shrouds, contributing to its aggressive and sporty aesthetic. For rider convenience, the bike is equipped with a 4.2-inch TFT display that supports Honda's RoadSync app for connected features like navigation, call/SMS alerts, and music playback. A USB Type-C charging port is also included.
Underneath its stylish exterior, the CB125 Hornet is built on a diamond-type frame and powered by a 123.94cc, 4-stroke, SI engine paired with a 5-speed gearbox. Braking is handled by a 240mm petal disc at the front and a 130mm drum at the rear, with single-channel ABS for enhanced safety. The bike rides on wide tubeless tires (80/100-17 front and 110/80-17 rear) and features a 5-step adjustable monoshock at the rear.

The newly released BMW R 1300 GS 2026 marks a bold evolution in the adventure touring segment, combining advanced technology with refined power. At its core lies a 1,300cc boxer engine delivering robust torque and smoother performance, paired with a lightweight chassis for enhanced agility on and off-road. The 2026 model introduces the next-gen Telelever front suspension and a reworked Paralever rear, improving handling dynamics. BMW has also integrated cutting-edge features like radar-assisted adaptive cruise control, a full-color TFT display with smartphone connectivity, and multiple riding modes for optimal adaptability. With its redesigned, more aggressive styling and a lower center of gravity, the new R 1300 GS stands as a flagship of performance, comfort, and innovation for long-distance adventurers.

Description: The newly released Moto Morini Alltrhike 450 2026 marks the Italian brand's foray into the small-displacement off-road segment, aiming to capture the spirit of "hike" and adventure. This adventure motorcycle is designed for versatility, performing well on both highways and rugged terrain. At its core is a 450cc parallel-twin, 4-stroke DOHC 8-valve engine, producing 43.5 horsepower (32.5kW) and 32.4 lb-ft (44Nm) of torque, meeting Euro 5+ emissions standards. Built on a steel tube frame with an aluminum swingarm, it features a fully adjustable USD Kayaba 41mm front fork with 210mm travel and a Kayaba monoshock with a progressive linkage offering 190mm of rear travel. The Alltrhike 450 sports a 21-inch front wheel and a 17-inch rear wheel, along with a braking system that includes a 320mm front disc with a 4-piston caliper and a 255mm rear disc with a dual-piston setup, complemented by dual-channel ABS that can be deactivated for off-road riding. Key features also include a digital dashboard with navigation, USB and USB-C ports, an adjustable windshield, a skid plate, and a center stand. With a dry weight of 170kg and an 18.5-liter fuel tank, the Alltrhike 450 is positioned as an accessible yet capable option for riders seeking adventure, including those with an A2 license.
specs: Upside-Down Kayaba ø41 mm, wheel travel 208 mm, adjustable in spring preload, damping setting in rebound and compression
Progressive linkage, Kayaba monoshock, wheel travel 190 mm, adjustable in spring preload, damping setting in rebound

Description: Honda has recently made a significant entry into the 150cc motorcycle segment with the official launch of the new Honda CG 150 2026, aiming to capture a market similar to how its CG 125 dominates its class. The newly launched CG 150 2026 offers a blend of traditional aesthetics and modern features, targeting riders who prioritize simplicity, reliability, and cost-effectiveness. The design echoes the classic CG 125, featuring a round LED headlight, chrome fenders, and a flat seat, complemented by a matte green fuel tank with golden badging and alloy wheels. Underneath its rugged, exposed frame, the motorcycle is powered by a fuel-efficient 150cc SOHC engine with a balancer shaft to reduce vibrations, supporting both kick-start and self-start functionalities. Key features include an all-forward gear transmission for smoother shifts, a combined brake system for enhanced safety, and LED lights for improved visibility. This launch signifies Honda's move beyond mere updates, offering a new model that seeks to strengthen its presence in the 150cc market.

The newly launched YADEA A7 2026 is an electric scooter (also known as a three-wheeled electric tricycle in some markets) designed for urban commuters seeking an eco-friendly and efficient mode of transportation. It features a compact, spacious design with dual rear wheels for added stability. Powered by a 500W motor and a 60V 23Ah graphene battery, the A7 has a range of 80 km per charge and a top speed of 24 km/h, suitable for city roads. Key features include an 18-month warranty on the motor and battery, front and rear drum brakes for reliable stopping power, 10-inch aluminum alloy rims with tubeless tires, and a fire-resistant battery for enhanced safety. With its modern aesthetic, reinforced high-strength steel frame, and focus on energy efficiency, the A7 is a compelling option in the evolving electric vehicle market.

The newly released 2026 BMW M 1000 XR is a testament to BMW Motorrad's pursuit of combining superbike performance with long-distance touring comfort, positioning itself as a "super-fast crossover." Building on the successful XR series, this M-badged machine retains its potent 999cc inline-four ShiftCam engine, powering the bike with 201 horsepower at 12,750 rpm. The engine revs up to a redline of 14,600 rpm. The 2026 model year brings a new Aurelius Green Metallic Matt color, further emphasizing its aggressive and luxurious M-Series character. Key highlights include aerodynamic M winglets for enhanced stability, advanced M brakes, Dynamic Damping Control (DDC) electronic suspension, and M-specific components, including the M titanium rear silencer, M forged wheels (with optional M Carbon wheels for even lighter weight), and an M start-up animation on its TFT display. Balancing performance and comfort, it offers features like heated grips, cruise control, and a supportive M seat.

Description: The newly released Lambretta X125 2026 has arrived, blending the brand's classic Italian heritage with modern design and technology. This 125cc scooter features a liquid-cooled, single-cylinder, 4-stroke, 4-valve engine with Bosch electronic fuel injection, delivering 9.5 kW (around 12.7 bhp) of power and 10 Nm of torque. It boasts a semi-monocoque steel chassis, a fixed front fender, and double linkage front suspension with dual rear shock absorbers for a comfortable ride. Riders will appreciate the contemporary conveniences like full LED lighting, a smart keyless ignition system, dual-channel ABS for enhanced safety, and a semi-digital display combining an analog speedometer with an LCD for essential information.

The Honda CB190TR 2026 is a lightweight neo-retro scrambler that draws heavy design cues from Honda’s larger Neo Sports Cafe family, such as the CB300R and CB650R. It features a round LED headlight, a sculpted 12-liter fuel tank, an exposed diamond-type frame, a single-piece seat, and a stubby upswept exhaust. Beneath its retro aesthetic lies a commuter-focused 184cc air-cooled, single-cylinder engine that produces roughly 16.7 horsepower and 16.3 Nm of torque, paired with a 5-speed gearbox and an assist/slipper clutch. Designed primarily for urban commuting and casual light-trail riding, it comes equipped with premium chassis hardware, including gold-finished upside-down (USD) front forks, a rear monoshock, front and rear disc brakes with dual-channel ABS, 17-inch alloy wheels, and a retro-style circular LCD instrument cluster.

CFMoto has recently made a splash in the scooter market with the launch of its 2026 CFMoto 150 Aura, a retro-inspired scooter that seamlessly blends vintage aesthetics with contemporary technology. Unveiled alongside two other 150cc scooters, the 150 SC (with bend pedal) and 150 SC-F (with flat pedal), the 150 Aura targets the growing retro segment.
The 150 Aura is offered in two variants: a basic version and a high-end version, both powered by a newly developed 149.5cc water-cooled four-valve engine. This engine delivers a maximum power of 11.8kW (approximately 15.8 horsepower) and a peak torque of 14.3 Nm, boasting a high compression ratio of 11.6:1, allowing for a 0-80km/h acceleration in just 8 seconds. Standard features across both variants include front and rear dual-channel ABS (Anti-lock Braking System) and TCS (Traction Control System), which can be manually turned on/off via the LCD screen.
Beyond its performance, the 150 Aura is packed with modern conveniences. It features a 6.2-inch TFT instrument panel with mobile phone connectivity, automatic start-stop, pulse ignition, tire pressure monitoring, two USB fast-charging ports (Type A + Type C), and even front and rear driving recorders. For enhanced comfort, heated handlebars are available. The scooter also offers multiple unlocking methods, including NFC card, mobile phone Bluetooth proximity, mobile phone app, and password unlocking, with electronically controlled faucet, fuel tank, and seat locks. Its practical design includes an 8L fuel tank, optimized seat height of 770mm, and a spacious under-seat storage that can accommodate an XL full-face helmet and a half helmet, making it an attractive option for urban commuters seeking a stylish yet functional ride.

The 2027 Harley-Davidson Sprint 440 brings together iconic Milwaukee-inspired styling and modern practicality in a lightweight, city-friendly cruiser. Designed for riders who appreciate classic Harley-Davidson character but want a more accessible and manageable motorcycle, the Sprint 440 strikes an appealing balance between traditional design, everyday comfort, and urban agility.
Its timeless appearance features familiar Harley-Davidson design elements, including a teardrop-shaped fuel tank and a stylish fastback seat. With a low 26.8-inch (683 mm) seat height and a manageable 412 lb (189 kg) running weight, the Sprint 440 offers an approachable riding experience, making it an attractive option for beginners and experienced riders looking for a lightweight urban motorcycle.
Power comes from an air-cooled, 440cc single-cylinder engine producing 27 horsepower and 28 lb-ft (38 Nm) of torque. Paired with a smooth six-speed transmission, the engine delivers accessible low-end power for navigating busy city streets, commuting through traffic, and enjoying relaxed weekend rides. It also offers enough performance for occasional light highway cruising.
The 2027 Harley-Davidson Sprint 440 features a capable suspension setup, including a 43mm inverted front fork and piggyback rear shocks, designed to provide a balanced and comfortable ride. Machined 10-spoke cast-aluminum wheels add to its premium appearance, while modern features such as full LED lighting and a round 3.5-inch color TFT display bring contemporary convenience to its classic styling.
specs: Monotube Piggy-Back Coil over Shocks with 7-step preload adjustment
Front: Black, 10-Spoke Cast Aluminum, Rear: Black, 10-Spoke Cast Aluminum

Description:
The newly launched Honda CD70 Dream 2026 continues the legacy of its predecessors by offering a reliable and economical commuting solution, albeit with a focus on cosmetic changes rather than a complete overhaul. The most prominent update for the 2026 model is a fresh set of stickers, which now feature a stylish new white and blue color scheme, replacing the previous yellow and white combination. The 'CD' lettering on the side has been given a cyan outline, a minor but noticeable design tweak for enthusiasts.
Under the hood, the bike retains the tried and tested 72cc, 4-stroke, OHC air-cooled engine, known for its fuel efficiency and durability. It comes with a 4-speed constant mesh transmission and a kick starter. The bike’s core specifications, including its dimensions, ground clearance, and fuel capacity of 8.6 liters, remain largely unchanged.

The newly-released 2026 Honda CB1000F successfully blends classic 1980s naked-bike aesthetics with cutting-edge modern engineering, establishing itself as a stylish and potent retro-roadster. Drawing its design inspiration from iconic machines like the legendary CB750F, the CB1000F features a timeless look characterized by a classic round LED headlight, flowing tank-to-tail lines, and a period-correct megaphone-style exhaust. Beneath this nostalgic skin lies the platform of the contemporary CB1000 Hornet, including a detuned version of the Fireblade-derived 999cc inline-four engine. This engine is specifically re-tuned with revised cam profiles and intake funnels to prioritize strong low- and mid-range torque, resulting in a more user-friendly powerband for everyday riding (peaking at approximately 122 hp and 76 lb-ft). The bike is equipped with premium components such as a Showa SFF-BP inverted fork, radial-mount Nissin brakes, and a comprehensive electronics suite including a six-axis IMU for Cornering ABS and selectable riding modes, all managed via a modern 5-inch TFT display.
specs: Separate pressurized single-tube type cushion unit pro link

Description: The Honda NS125LA 2026 is a 125cc scooter that stands out with its retro-classic design and modern features. It's a scooter that blends a stylish, simple aesthetic with contemporary technology, making it an attractive option for urban commuters. The scooter is powered by a 124cc, air-cooled, single-cylinder engine that delivers smooth and efficient performance, and it is equipped with Honda's PGM-FI intelligent fuel injection system. For rider convenience, it features an elegant storage box, spacious under-seat storage that can fit a 3/4 helmet, and a 20W dual-port fast-charging system with both Type A and C ports. The scooter also emphasizes safety with options for both CBS (Combined Brake System) and ABS (Anti-lock Braking System) versions, as well as an I-STOP system for improved fuel efficiency. With its distinctive "smiley face" taillight and retro-style sofa seat, the NS125LA offers a unique and comfortable riding experience.

The newly released CFMoto 750SR-S 2026 marks a bold step forward in the brand’s sportbike lineup, blending aggressive styling with advanced performance. This middleweight supersport motorcycle is powered by a potent 750cc parallel-twin engine, delivering impressive power and torque for both spirited track rides and dynamic road performance. With its sharp aerodynamic fairings, LED lighting, and sleek tail design, the 750SR-S carries a race-inspired aesthetic. The 2026 model comes equipped with modern tech such as a full-color TFT display, multiple riding modes, traction control, and ABS for enhanced safety and control. Designed for riders who crave precision handling and high-speed thrills, the CFMoto 750SR-S 2026 stands as a serious contender in the competitive sportbike segment.
specs: ABS, dual channel, and adjustable traction control
Front: KYB USD fork, fully adjustable Rear: KYB monoshock, single-sided swingarm, fully adjustable
LED headlights, taillights, and signal lights; 5" TFT display with Bluetooth and CFMOTO RideSync connectivity. Tire pressure monitor, Upper-quick shifter, USB type-C

Description: The YADEA M3 2026 is an electric scooter designed for urban riders seeking a blend of style, efficiency, and eco-friendliness. It is equipped with a 60V 23Ah Graphene battery, which is designed for longevity. The scooter has a maximum speed of 42 km/h and an impressive range of up to 80 km on a single charge. The YADEA M3 also features an efficient braking system with front and rear disc brakes, 12-inch alloy wheels, and a digital dashboard that provides real-time information about battery life. The scooter's frame is constructed from cold-rolled steel, and it has a high-strength aluminum rear swing arm, ensuring durability. It also includes an alarm system and immobilizer for security.

The newly launched QJ Motor SRK250S 2026 is a compelling addition to the 250cc sport naked motorcycle segment. The bike features a sharp, modern design and is powered by a liquid-cooled, single-cylinder EFI engine that delivers 27.49 hp and 22.5 Nm of torque. This is paired with a six-speed gearbox and a wet, multi-plate clutch. With a claimed dry weight of 148 kg and a seat height of 780 mm, the SRK250S is designed to be accessible to a wide range of riders. The SRK250S comes with a fully digital instrument cluster with Bluetooth connectivity, full LED lighting, dual-channel ABS, upside-down front forks, and a preload-adjustable rear monoshock. The bike is available in Black and Grey, making it a stylish and value-for-money option for riders seeking a blend of performance and modern technology in the 250cc class.

The newly released 2027 Kawasaki KLX230 SHERPA S is a dual-sport motorcycle designed for both city commuting and off-road exploration. It features a rider-friendly character with a low 32.5-inch seat height, making it accessible to a wide range of riders. Powering the bike is a 233cc air-cooled, fuel-injected, single-cylinder engine paired with a 6-speed transmission, providing a blend of low-speed control for trails and smooth acceleration for the road. The bike comes equipped with a number of features that enhance its versatility, including an aluminum skid plate, handguards, and a selectable ABS braking system that can be turned off for off-road use. The KLX230 SHERPA S also boasts modern technology, with an all-digital instrument panel that includes smartphone connectivity via the Kawasaki RIDEOLOGY THE APP. With its rugged styling, functional design, and approachable performance, the 2027 KLX230 SHERPA S is an excellent option for riders seeking a capable and confidence-inspiring machine for various riding conditions.
specs: ERGO-FIT, Even lower seat height, Aluminum skid plate, Hand guards, All-digital Instrumentation with Smartphone Connectivity
Uni-Trak linkage system and single shock with adjustable spring preload/6.6 in

Description: The newly released 2027 Kawasaki KLX230 DF is a dual-sport motorcycle designed for riders who want a versatile machine capable of handling both city streets and off-road trails. The "DF" designation stands for "Dual-Purpose, Functional," and the bike lives up to its name with a rugged and utilitarian aesthetic. Building on the established KLX230 platform, the DF model features a 233cc air-cooled, fuel-injected single-cylinder engine paired with a 6-speed transmission, providing a good balance of low-speed torque for trail riding and smooth acceleration for on-road use. It comes with longer-travel suspension compared to its sibling, the KLX230 Sherpa S, offering 7.9 inches of travel in the front and 8.8 inches in the rear, which contributes to a more aggressive off-road stance and a higher ground clearance of 9.4 inches. The KLX230 DF is also equipped with a range of off-road focused features as standard, including an aluminum skid plate, engine guards, a rear carrier, and metal-reinforced handguards. A key safety feature is the selectable ABS, which allows riders to turn off the anti-lock braking function on the rear wheel for better control in certain off-road conditions. The bike also incorporates modern technology, such as an all-digital instrument panel with smartphone connectivity via the Kawasaki Rideology app.
specs: ERGO-FIT, Aluminum skid plate, Engine guards, Hand guards, All-digital Instrumentation with Smartphone Connectivity
Uni-Trak linkage system and single shock with adjustable spring preload

Description:
The TVS NTORQ 150 2026 is a significant addition to the brand's scooter category, positioned as a high-performance "hyper sport scooter" aimed at Gen Z riders, building upon the success of its popular 125cc sibling. The NTORQ 150 features an aggressive, futuristic design inspired by stealth aircraft, with bold styling elements like multi-point projector headlights, integrated winglets for aerodynamics, and naked motorcycle-style handlebars. Powering this scooter is a 149.7cc air-cooled, 3-valve engine that delivers 13.2 hp and 14.2 Nm of torque, making it one of the quickest in its class, with a claimed top speed of 104 km/h.
Beyond its performance, the NTORQ 150 is packed with advanced technology. It comes with a 5-inch TFT display and the TVS SmartXonnect system, offering over 50 connected features including turn-by-turn navigation, call/message alerts, music control, and even Alexa and smartwatch integration. For enhanced safety and control, the scooter is equipped with segment-first features like ABS and traction control, along with two riding modes, Street and Race. The NTORQ 150 blends race-inspired performance, cutting-edge connectivity, and practical features like 22 liters of under-seat storage and an adjustable brake lever, solidifying its position as a feature-rich and performance-oriented offering in the scooter segment.

The Yadea Velax 2026 has been officially launched in several markets. This new electric scooter is designed for urban commuting, blending a sleek, sporty design with eco-friendly technology. Depending on the market and specific variant, the Velax comes with different specifications. For instance, some models feature a 4,900W motor with a top speed of up to 80 km/h, while others have a 2 kW motor with a governed top speed of 62 km/h. Battery options also vary, with some models offering a range of up to 110 km on a single charge and others with a 105 km range. Many variants also feature smart technology, such as the AiGo system for app-based unlocking and remote control, as well as an AiSafety system with real-time alerts. The scooter is also built with practicality in mind, boasting IPX7 water resistance for the motor and battery, full LED lighting, and a USB charging port.

The Hero Eco 150 is a motorcycle designed primarily for commercial and everyday commuting purposes. It's known for its practicality, durability, and economical operation. The bike is powered by a 149.1cc, air-cooled, single-cylinder engine that produces between 13.4 and 14.3 HP and 12.8 N-m of torque, paired with a 5-speed gearbox.
Key features of the Eco 150 often highlight its focus on utility and low running costs. It typically comes equipped with a high-output USB charging point, a center stand for easy maintenance, and a robust frame designed for carrying a payload. Some variants, like the Eco 150 TR, are more rugged and include features like spoked wheels, all-terrain tires, and handguards, making them suitable for mixed-use on both paved and unpaved roads.
What sets the Eco 150 apart is its impressive fuel efficiency, reportedly achieving up to 60 km/l, combined with a generous 12.5-liter fuel tank, giving it a long range. With its simple design, comfortable ergonomics, and reputation for reliability, the Hero Eco 150 is a popular choice for delivery personnel, small business owners, and daily commuters seeking a dependable and affordable workhorse.

Description: The SYM FUGUE 125 is a modern-classic scooter that combines vintage aesthetics with contemporary features. It is powered by a 124.6cc single-cylinder, 4-stroke, air-cooled engine with electronic fuel injection (EFI), which provides a rated output of 8 kW (approximately 10.7 horsepower) at 8250 rpm. The scooter features a full LED lighting system, an LCD instrument panel, and a USB QC 3.0 port for charging devices. For safety, it is equipped with double disc brakes with either ABS or CBS. It also offers practical elements like a 27-liter under-seat storage compartment, which can fit a helmet. With a lightweight curb weight of 130 kg and a CVT automatic transmission, the FUGUE 125 is designed to be an agile and user-friendly option for urban commuters.

The Yadea RS20 2026 is a powerful electric scooter that stands out in the urban mobility landscape. Equipped with a 2450W motor, it reaches a top speed of 51 km/h, making it suitable for city commutes and light recreational use. A key feature is its dual battery system, providing a remarkable range of up to 105 km on a single charge, addressing a major concern for electric vehicle users. The scooter also incorporates modern amenities like a full-color LCD display, LED lighting, and a smart app for connectivity and real-time data. Designed for comfort and stability, the RS20 features a robust frame, hydraulic shock absorbers, and disc brakes on both wheels, ensuring a safe and smooth ride.
specs: F: Disc Brake, R: Disc Brake

Description: The newly released 2026 Buell Super Cruiser successfully bridges the gap between aggressive West Coast club-style aesthetics and raw American superbike performance. Born from a high-profile collaboration between Buell Motorcycle Co. and legendary custom builder Roland Sands, this highly anticipated machine trades Buell’s traditional aluminum chassis for a flexible, steel-tube frame modeled with unmistakable Harley FXR-inspired geometry. Beneath the high-mounted bars, a Memphis Shades cafe fairing, and a custom Saddlemen seat lies a liquid-cooled 1190cc ET-V2 V-twin engine that pumps out a massive 175 horsepower and 94 lb-ft of torque. By pairing this intense power plant with premium componentry—including a dual-disc Brembo braking system, fully adjustable FOX suspension, and a featherweight wet weight of just 485 pounds (minus fuel)—the Super Cruiser boasts a staggering power-to-weight ratio that behaves more like a naked sportbike than a traditional heavyweight cruiser.
specs: Electronic Fuel injection with 2 port injectors & 2 showerhead injectors Primary + Secondary

Description: The 2026 Honda CRF300F is an all-new model that replaces the popular CRF250F as the flagship of Honda's trail bike lineup. The most significant update is the new 294cc air-cooled, single-cylinder engine, which provides a notable boost in power and torque. This larger engine is paired with a new six-speed transmission, giving riders a wider range of gearing options for various terrains, from tight trails to more open spaces. The bike also features several chassis improvements aimed at enhancing handling and durability. The conventional fork has been given new settings for better performance and resistance to bottoming, while the rear suspension link and bottom triple clamp are now made from aluminum, resulting in weight savings and improved feel. Other updates include an oil cooler for increased reliability in hot conditions, a more heat-resistant clutch, and revised bodywork inspired by Honda's CRF Performance line.

The Can-Am Canyon 2026 is a three-wheel adventure motorcycle designed for both paved roads and dirt trails. It is part of the 2025 Can-Am lineup and is powered by a Rotax 1330 ACE in-line 3-cylinder engine, producing 115 horsepower and 96 lb-ft of torque. The Canyon features a semi-automatic 6-speed transmission and offers four distinct driving modes: Normal, Sport, All-road, and Rally, allowing riders to adapt to various terrains. The vehicle is built for stability, with high ground clearance, extended suspension travel, and XPS adventure tires. The Canyon also includes a 10.25" touchscreen display with Apple CarPlay compatibility, a LinQ system for customizable storage, and an adjustable windshield. The premium Redrock model adds features like semi-active KYB Smart-Shox suspension and a backup camera.
specs: Rotax 1330 ACE in-line 3 cylinders, liquid-cooled with electronic fuel injection and electronic throttle control
270 mm discs with Brembo plus, 4-piston fixed caliper

Description: The Lifan K29 (LF250-14M) is a modern street motorcycle that stands out with its blend of sporty aesthetics and practical performance. Designed to appeal to a wide range of riders, from urban commuters to weekend enthusiasts, it features a sleek and aggressive design language. At its heart lies a reliable single-cylinder, 250cc engine, which provides a balance of sufficient power for city riding and highway cruising, while remaining fuel-efficient. The K29 2026 is typically equipped with features like a digital instrument cluster, LED lighting, and disc brakes on both front and rear wheels, enhancing both safety and convenience. Its ergonomic design, with a comfortable riding position and well-padded seat, makes it suitable for daily use and longer journeys.

The Honda CB300F 2027 is a naked streetfighter motorcycle that stands out as a versatile and approachable option for a wide range of riders, particularly those new to the mid-displacement segment. It is powered by a 293.52cc, oil-cooled, single-cylinder engine that delivers a smooth and tractable powerband, with a focus on low and mid-range torque perfect for navigating urban traffic. Additionally, the bike's lightweight nature (153 kg curb weight) and comfortable ergonomics, including a low 789mm seat height, make it highly manageable and easy to handle in city environments.
Beyond its commuter-friendly character, the CB300F is equipped with modern features that enhance both safety and convenience. It comes with dual-channel ABS for confident braking, a slipper clutch for smooth gear shifts, and some variants come with Honda Selectable Torque Control (HSTC) for added safety in low-traction conditions. Furthermore, the bike sports a fully digital instrument console, all-around LED lighting, and a USB-C charging port.

The TVS Radeon 2026 is a popular commuter motorcycle that has carved a niche for itself in the highly competitive 110cc segment. Known for its sturdy build quality, comfortable ride, and excellent fuel efficiency, the Radeon is powered by a 109.7cc Dura-Life engine that delivers a balanced mix of power and mileage, making it an ideal choice for daily city commutes. The bike stands out with its classic, yet stylish design, featuring chrome accents and a long, well-cushioned seat that enhances rider and pillion comfort. Modern amenities such as a digital cluster with real-time mileage display (on the Digi-Cluster variants), a USB charging port, and a Synchronized Braking System (SBT) further add to its practicality and value-for-money proposition.

The Can-Am Maverick R 2026 continues its legacy as a top-tier performance side-by-side, offering a range of variants tailored for different off-road disciplines. At its core, the Maverick R lineup is powered by a turbocharged 999cc Rotax ACE triple-cylinder engine, delivering an impressive 240 horsepower. This power is managed by a recalibrated dual-clutch transmission (DCT) for smoother, sharper acceleration. A key feature across the lineup is the advanced suspension, which includes a forged aluminum heavy-duty Tall Knuckle and a 4-Link Trailing arm setup, providing exceptional travel (24-25 inches) and durability. The 2026 models also boast a new 10.25-inch touchscreen display with integrated GPS and other connected features, enhancing the in-cab experience.
The Maverick R comes in several specialized variants, each with its own unique characteristics. The Maverick R X and its four-seat counterpart, the Maverick R MAX X, serve as the base models, equipped with FOX 2.5 PODIUM Piggyback shocks and a Smart-Lok front differential. For those seeking even higher performance, the Maverick R X rs and Maverick R MAX X rs add premium features like FOX 3.0 PODIUM RC2 shocks with bypass, and the option for Can-Am's Gen 3 Smart-Shox semi-active suspension. A new addition to the 2026 lineup is the Maverick R X rc, specifically engineered for rock crawling. This variant features a low-gear transmission, a specialized ROCK mode on the Smart-Lok differential, and massive 35-inch XPS Hammer King tires, along with a steering damper and reinforced protection. This diverse lineup ensures that whether a rider is tackling dunes, trails, or technical rock sections, there's a Maverick R built to conquer the challenge.

Description: The TVS Raider 125 2027 is a popular commuter motorcycle due to its stylish design and sporty performance. Aimed at youth, it features a sharp, aggressive look with distinctive LED headlamps and a muscular fuel tank. The motorcycle is powered by a 124.8cc single-cylinder, air-and-oil-cooled engine that delivers a healthy balance of power and fuel efficiency. A key highlight is its advanced, fully digital instrument cluster, which offers a host of information, including a gear position indicator, range, and top-speed recorder. The Raider 125 also stands out with its segment-first features like a two-valve engine and five-speed gearbox, contributing to a smooth and responsive ride.
specs: Air & Oil cooled single cylinder, SI

Description: The Lifan LF150T-8G, also known as the Lifan Blues 150, is a scooter model that combines practicality with a distinctive design. Marketed for urban commuting, the scooter features a 150cc engine, which provides a good balance of power and fuel efficiency for navigating city streets. Its styling is often noted for a retro-inspired aesthetic, with a mix of classic lines and modern features. The Blues 150 2026 typically comes equipped with an automatic transmission, making it easy to operate for riders of varying experience levels. With a comfortable seat and adequate under-seat storage, it serves as a reliable and stylish option for daily errands and short-distance travel.

The Lifan KPV350 2026, also known as the LF350T, is a maxi-scooter with a single-cylinder, water-cooled, four-stroke engine. With a displacement of 349.9 mL, it produces a maximum power of 25.5 kW at 7500 rpm and a maximum torque of 35.5 Nm at 6000 rpm. The scooter features electronic fuel injection, a continuously variable transmission, and a disc brake system on both the front and rear wheels. It has a wheelbase of 1520 mm, a ground clearance of 145 mm, and a seat height of 780 mm. The fuel tank capacity is 15.5 L, and the net weight is 186 kg. The KPV350 has an official top speed of 135 km/h.

The SYM Husky 150 2025 is a stylish and functional scooter that stands out in the competitive 150cc class, often seen as a direct rival to models like the Honda ADV 160. It features an aggressive, adventure-style design with sharp lines and a sporty look. Powered by a 150cc single-cylinder, liquid-cooled engine, it offers a good balance of power and efficiency, delivering around 14 horsepower and 14.5 Nm of torque. A key selling point for the Husky 150 is its generous 15-liter fuel tank, which provides an impressive riding range. The scooter is also well-equipped with modern features, including a keyless ignition system, a USB charging port, a full-LED lighting system, and a digital TFT instrument panel. For enhanced safety, it comes standard with a dual-channel ABS and Traction Control System (TCS).

The SYM ADXTG 400 2025 is a bold step into the adventure scooter category, blending rugged capability with urban practicality. Powered by a 399cc liquid-cooled engine, it delivers strong performance for both city commutes and long-distance touring, while its ADV-inspired design gives it a commanding presence. The scooter features long-travel suspension, high ground clearance, and dual-purpose tires, making it ready to handle light off-road trails with confidence. Modern tech such as LED lighting, a TFT display, traction control, and multiple riding modes ensure a premium riding experience.

The YADEA OCEAN 2026 is a stylish electric scooter designed for urban and short-distance commuting. It features a sleek design and is available in a variety of colors. The scooter is powered by an 800W motor with a peak power of 1600W, allowing for a top speed of 46 km/h. It is equipped with a 60V 22Ah Graphene TTFAR battery, which provides a range of up to 70 km on a single charge. The YADEA OCEAN also includes practical features such as a 6.2-inch liquid crystal display, an 18-liter storage compartment, and LED lighting. With its low seat height and ergonomic design, the scooter is particularly well-suited for a comfortable riding experience, especially for shorter riders.

The Yadea GT20 2026 is a new electric scooter designed for urban commuting. It boasts a 2,000W hub motor with a peak power of 3,200W, enabling a top speed of 60 km/h and maximum torque of 160 Nm. Powered by a 72V 38Ah graphene battery, it provides a range of up to 105 km on a single charge, with a lifespan three times longer than standard lithium-ion batteries. Charging takes approximately 6-8 hours. The GT20 features sporty design elements, including LED lighting, a digital display, and 28 liters of under-seat storage. Safety features include front and rear disc brakes with a Combined Braking System (CBS).

The 2026 Husqvarna FE 501s is a dual-sport motorcycle that has been updated with several refinements for the new model year. The most significant changes are to the WP XACT suspension, which now features polished springs, a new pressure reservoir, and a one-piece hydrostop for enhanced damping. The bike also sports a redesigned fuel tank, a new fuel line protector cap for improved durability, and a threaded radiator cap for easier maintenance. Visually, the 2026 FE 501s is distinguished by new radiator shrouds, fork guards, and graphics inspired by the brand's Swedish heritage. The motorcycle is powered by a 510.9cc single-cylinder engine and is equipped with a six-speed transmission, Brembo hydraulic clutch, and brake systems.
specs: Wet, DDS multi-disc clutch, Brembo hydraulics

Description: The newly released Husqvarna FE 350s 2026 is a refined update to an already highly capable dual-sport motorcycle, designed to strike a balance between manageable power and agile handling. While not a radical redesign from the 2025 model, the 2026 FE 350s introduces a number of key refinements for improved performance and durability. A primary highlight is the revised suspension, featuring technical changes to the WP XACT Closed Cartridge forks and a new WP XACT rear shock. These updates include polished springs and a one-piece hydrostop for enhanced damping characteristics, and the rear shock now has tool-free adjusters. The bike also receives a new, reshaped fuel tank designed to maximize fuel consumption and a new threaded radiator cap for easier coolant checks. Styling updates include new radiator shrouds, fork guards, and graphics that continue to honor the brand's Swedish heritage.
specs: Wet, DDS multi-disc clutch, Brembo hydraulics

Description:
The Royal Enfield Bear 650 2026 is a motorcycle that pays homage to the scramblers of the 1960s, drawing inspiration from Eddie Mulder's victory at the 1960 Big Bear Run on a Royal Enfield. Built on the brand's popular 650cc parallel-twin platform, the Bear 650 distinguishes itself with a scrambler-specific design and upgraded components. It features a strengthened double-cradle frame, an all-new subframe, and a higher seat height of 830mm compared to its siblings. The bike's styling is characterized by its kicked-up rear loop, a scrambler-style bench seat, and chunky, dual-purpose MRF Nylorex tires on a 19-inch front and 17-inch rear spoked wheel setup.
Powering the Bear 650 is the familiar 648cc air/oil-cooled parallel-twin engine, which has been retuned to deliver an 8% increase in peak torque, now at 56.5 Nm at 5,150 rpm, while maintaining a peak power output of 47 bhp. This is achieved with a new 2-into-1 exhaust system that also reduces weight and mass. The bike's suspension is upgraded to a Showa-sourced setup, with 43mm upside-down forks at the front and twin shocks at the rear, offering more travel than the Interceptor 650. For modern functionality, the Bear 650 is equipped with a full-color TFT Tripper Dash display with Bluetooth connectivity and Google Maps-powered navigation, as well as full LED lighting and switchable dual-channel ABS.

Description: The 2026 Husqvarna 701 Enduro is positioned as a benchmark in the large-displacement, single-cylinder dual-sport segment, arriving with a host of significant updates. At its heart is a redesigned 692cc LC4 engine, now compliant with Euro 5+ emissions standards while boosting performance from 74 PS to 79 PS. This enhanced power unit features a new exhaust with a relocated catalyst, revised valve timing for stronger low-RPM torque, and a redesigned airbox, all contributing to a more responsive ride. The new model also sees a major upgrade in technology, centered around a 4.2-inch TFT dashboard that provides enhanced connectivity through the Ride HQV App, offering features like turn-by-turn navigation and music player integration. For off-road enthusiasts, the bike introduces a dedicated button to fully disengage the ABS, and an optional Rally Mode with a new "Dynamic Slip Adjust" feature that intelligently allows for rear-wheel slip when needed on challenging terrain before returning to the chosen traction control settings.
specs: Keihin EMS with RBW, twin ignition
Forced oil lubrication with 2 oil pumps
Two-channel Bosch 9.1 MP ABS (incl. Cornering ABS and Supermoto mode Disengegable)
Brembo twin-piston floating calliper, brake disc
Brembo single-piston floating calliper, brake disc
Chromium-Molybdenum steel trellis frame, powder coated

Description:
The Honda WN7 is Honda's first full-size electric naked motorcycle, unveiled in September 2025, evolving from the EV Fun Concept shown at EICMA 2024. Designed for the "Fun" segment, the WN7 combines a striking, futuristic naked-bike aesthetic with Honda's long legacy of stability, balance, and riding enjoyment.
Some key specs: it offers over 130 km of range on a single charge using its fixed lithium-ion battery. Charging is versatile—fast charging via CCS2 lets you go from about 20% to 80% in 30 minutes, while home or wall-box charging (6 kVA) fills the battery fully in under 3 hours. The powertrain features an 18 kW water-cooled motor (with a lower-power 11 kW version for A1 license in some markets), delivering power akin to a mid-size ICE (600cc) bike, but torque nearer to larger 1000cc machines. Other features include a 5-inch TFT display with Honda RoadSync for connectivity, LED lighting front and rear, and a kerb weight of about 217 kg.
specs: Performance comparable to a 600cc internal combustion engine (ICE) motorcycle
100 Nm, comparable to a 1000cc ICE motorcycle
Over 130 km (83 miles) on a single charge
Full charge in under 3 hours with a 6kVA home charger

Description:
The Ducati Panigale V4 R 2026 is a masterpiece of engineering, representing the pinnacle of the Italian manufacturer's racing prowess. Designed as the homologation model for the 2026 World Superbike Championship, this bike is the closest a rider can get to a factory Ducati race machine. At its core is the 998cc Desmosedici Stradale R engine, meticulously refined to meet Euro 5+ emissions standards while delivering breathtaking performance. With a stock output of 218 hp, this figure can soar to a staggering 239 hp with the optional Akrapovic titanium racing exhaust and special racing oil, pushing the top speed beyond 330 km/h (205 mph).
Beyond raw power, the Panigale V4 R 2026 showcases a host of innovations directly trickled down from Ducati's MotoGP program. The chassis features a revised "Front Frame" with reduced lateral stiffness for improved cornering feel and a new double-sided hollow symmetrical swingarm for enhanced traction. Aerodynamic enhancements are also a key focus, with larger wings and the introduction of "Corner Sidepods" designed to generate downforce even at extreme lean angles, allowing for higher cornering speeds and tighter lines. The bike's electronics suite is equally impressive, featuring a dedicated "Track Evo" display on the TFT dash with a "Grip Meter" that provides real-time tire feedback, a race-spec gearbox with neutral below first gear, and a full array of rider aids.

6-Speed with duacti quick shift(DQS) up/down Evo 2

Description: The 2027 Kawasaki Teryx KRX 1000 continues its reign as a top-tier sport side-by-side, offering a blend of robust performance and advanced capability across several specialized editions, including the standard model, the high-tech eS, the aggressive Blackout Edition, and the new-for-2027 Rock Edition. All models are powered by a potent 999cc, liquid-cooled, parallel-twin engine, producing 110.0 hp and 75.2 lb-ft of torque, mated to an automatic CVT with selectable 2WD/4WD and a locking front differential. Key differentiators in the 2027 line include the eS model's Kawasaki Electronic Control Suspension (KECS) with FOX 2.5 Live Valve shocks and a TFT full-color display, while the new Rock Edition is specifically geared for boulder-crawling with 32-inch Maxxis Roxxzilla tires, bead-lock wheels, a broadened stance, and a WARN winch. The standard and four-seater KRX4 models for 2027 also receive updates like new Showa 2.5 piggyback shocks to enhance cabin comfort and ride quality over diverse terrain, solidifying the KRX 1000's reputation as a durable and formidable off-road machine.
specs: Double wishbone, Showa 2.5 shocks with piggyback reservoir, fully adjustable preload, and 24-position adjustable compression damping
4-link trailing-arm rear suspension, Showa 2.5 shocks with piggyback reservoir, fully adjustable preload, and 24-position adjustable compression damping

Description: The 2026 Ducati Scrambler Nightshift continues to embody the elegant, cafe racer-inspired spirit of the Scrambler family, introducing a striking new Emerald Green livery inspired by 1970s motorsport icons. Positioned as the most refined model, it features classic touches like a stitched seat, a flat, variable-section handlebar with bar-end mirrors, and black spoked wheels. Beneath the retro aesthetic, the bike is modernized with the updated 803cc Desmodue L-twin engine, now paired with a new, more compact eight-plate clutch for smoother operation and a 4 kg weight reduction for improved agility. Standard rider aids are comprehensive, including Ride-by-Wire throttle with two selectable Riding Modes, Ducati Traction Control, and Cornering ABS, all viewed through an eye-catching 4.3-inch TFT display, making it a stylish and technologically accessible option for riders.

Description: The newly unveiled 2027 Kawasaki KLE500 marks the return of a beloved nameplate, positioning itself as a serious contender in the middleweight adventure motorcycle segment. Powering this dual-sport is a 451cc liquid-cooled parallel-twin engine, similar to the one found in the Ninja 500 and Eliminator, but tuned for a linear torque band ideal for mixed-surface riding. Its rally-inspired design is supported by genuine off-road credentials, including a high-tensile steel trellis frame, a 21-inch front and 17-inch rear spoked wheel setup, and long-travel KYB inverted cartridge-type front forks. With selectable ABS for off-road use and an SE variant offering premium features like a TFT display and enhanced protection, the KLE500 promises a versatile, accessible, and rugged platform for riders looking to bridge the gap between daily commuting and trail exploration.

Description:
The Honda CBR500R Four 2027 brings a new level of excitement to the middleweight supersport segment, combining aggressive CBR styling with the thrilling performance and distinctive sound of a four-cylinder engine. At its heart is a newly developed 502cc, liquid-cooled, DOHC inline-four engine that reportedly produces around 69 hp at 11,000 rpm and 46.3 Nm of torque at 10,500 rpm. With a claimed top speed of approximately 210 km/h, the motorcycle promises an engaging, high-revving riding experience. Unlike the standard Honda CBR500R, which uses a parallel-twin engine, the CBR500R Four emphasizes the smooth power delivery, refined performance, and unmistakable character of an inline-four powerplant.
Adding to its modern appeal, the motorcycle reportedly features Honda E-Clutch technology, allowing clutch-free starts, stops, and gear changes while retaining the option of manual clutch operation. Its electronic package is said to include throttle-by-wire, five riding modes, Honda Selectable Torque Control, and wheelie control. A 5-inch TFT instrument display with Honda RoadSync connectivity provides modern convenience, while a 41mm inverted front fork, Pro-Link rear suspension, and ABS are designed to support confident handling and controlled braking.
The Honda CBR500R Four also combines practical dimensions with a sporty design. It reportedly has a kerb weight of 189 kg, a seat height of 780 mm, and 17-inch wheels, complemented by sharp bodywork inspired by Honda’s CBR supersport lineup. Overall, the CBR500R Four aims to deliver the excitement of a high-revving, four-cylinder motorcycle in a middleweight package, offering a compelling alternative to conventional twin-cylinder sportbikes and larger, more powerful superbikes.
specs: 51.8 kW @ 11,000 rpm (35 kW A2-compliant version also available)

Description: The newly launched Ducati DesertX V2 2026 marks a major evolution in Ducati’s adventure-bike lineup, blending rugged off-road capability with advanced modern tech. Unveiled as the second-generation DesertX for 2026, this bike is completely redesigned around Ducati’s all-new 890 cc V2 twin-cylinder engine, which delivers around 110 hp and 92 Nm of torque, and features an intelligent variable intake system for strong power across the rev range. What sets it apart from its predecessor is a new aluminium monocoque chassis that uses the engine as a stressed member, helping cut weight and improve rigidity, as well as fully adjustable KYB suspension, Brembo braking hardware and a range of electronic assists like multi-level cornering ABS, traction and wheelie control managed by a six-axis IMU. Ergonomics and design have been refined for both road and rough terrain riding, with revised footpeg position, a slimmer 18-litre tank for a lower centre of gravity, tubeless spoked wheels, six riding modes and a modern 5-inch TFT display. The DesertX V2 brings Ducati’s rally-inspired adventure bike into a new era of performance and versatility for riders seeking both long-distance touring prowess and serious off-road capability.
specs: Riding Modes, Power Modes, ABS Cornering, Ducati Traction Control, Ducati Wheelie Control, Daytime Running Light, Ducati Cornering Light, Ducati Brake Light, Vehicle Hold Control, Blind Spot Detection

Description: The 2026 Kawasaki Z250 maintains its position as a fierce entry-level streetfighter, with the official model focusing on fresh cosmetic enhancements rather than major mechanical changes. It continues to be powered by the reliable 248cc water-cooled DOHC parallel-twin engine, which produces 35 PS and 22 Nm of torque, paired with a six-speed transmission and built around a lightweight trellis frame showcasing Kawasaki's "Sugomi" design. The main update for the 2026 model year is a new color scheme, specifically a rugged "Ebony x Metallic Carbon Gray" finish with a black frame and updated graphics.
specs: Swingarm (bottom link uni-track, spring preload adjustable)
OVERALL DIMENSIONS (L X W X H)

Description:
The CFMoto 1000 MT-X —marketed as the CFMoto Ibex 950 in the U.S.—is the brand’s latest flagship adventure motorcycle, designed to compete in the liter-class ADV segment with a strong mix of performance and off-road capability. It is powered by a 946cc liquid-cooled parallel-twin engine, producing roughly 110–113 hp and 105 Nm of torque, delivering smooth yet punchy performance for both touring and rugged terrain. Built on a serious adventure-focused platform, it features long-travel KYB suspension, 21-inch front and 18-inch rear spoked wheels, and premium Brembo brakes, making it capable on dirt as well as highways.
The bike also comes loaded with modern electronics, including a ride-by-wire throttle, multiple riding aids such as traction control and cornering ABS, a quickshifter, cruise control, and a large 8-inch TFT display with connectivity. With a sizeable fuel tank (around 22.5 liters), adjustable ergonomics, and touring-friendly features like heated grips and seat, the 1000 MT-X positions itself as a value-packed, high-tech alternative to established adventure bikes, marking a major step forward for CFMoto in the global premium segment.
specs: 90/90 R21, Pirelli STR/150/70 R18, Pirelli STR

Description: The 2026 Ducati Multistrada V4 Rally, unveiled as the brand's ultimate long-distance adventure tourer, refines its formula with advanced technology, enhanced comfort, and greater all-terrain capability. It retains the powerful 1,158cc V4 Granturismo engine, delivering 170 horsepower, now paired with an updated Ducati Quick Shift 2.0 system and an extended rear-cylinder deactivation feature for improved efficiency. Key updates center on its chassis and electronics, featuring a sophisticated Adaptive Ducati Skyhook Suspension (DSS) EVO with 200mm of travel and a new Automatic Lowering Device for easier low-speed maneuvering. The radar-based safety suite is augmented with a new Forward Collision Warning system, complementing Adaptive Cruise Control and Blind Spot Detection. Designed for globe-trotting comfort, it boasts a substantial 30-litre fuel tank, a wider/taller windscreen, standard heated grips, and repositioned pannier mounts for improved passenger legroom, reinforcing its position as a premium machine ready for any horizon.

Description: The newly released 2026 Can-Am Outlander Electric marks a significant step in the powersports industry, introducing a mass-produced, all-electric ATV designed to combine powerful utility with quiet, eco-friendly performance. Powered by the in-house Rotax E-Power unit, the electric Outlander delivers an impressive 47 horsepower and 53 lb-ft of torque, enabling an industry-leading towing capacity of 1,830 lbs and a range of up to 50 miles (80 km) in optimal conditions. Its 8.9 kWh liquid-cooled battery can fast-charge from 20% to 80% in as little as 50 minutes using a Level 2 charger, minimizing downtime. Crucially, the ATV's focus on Advanced Quiet Technology, including noise-reducing tires and a low-noise cooling system, offers a near-silent riding experience, appealing greatly to farmers, hunters, and adventure seekers who wish to connect with nature without disturbance. The vehicle also includes selectable ride modes (Normal, Sport, Work) and a durable design for all-terrain capability, setting a new benchmark for electric off-road utility.

Description: The Yadea GS80 2026 is an urban-focused electric scooter designed to offer a practical blend of efficiency, comfort, and modern tech for daily commuting. Powered by a robust hub motor paired with a high-capacity lithium battery, it delivers smooth acceleration and a usable real-world range suited for city riders. The GS80 features a sleek, contemporary design with LED lighting, a digital display, and ergonomic seating that enhances rider comfort on longer trips. With convenient features like keyless start, multiple ride modes, and reliable braking hardware, the Yadea GS80 positions itself as an appealing option for those seeking an affordable, eco-friendly alternative to traditional petrol scooters without compromising on style or functionality.

The Yadea G6 2026 is a premium electric maxi-scooter designed for the urban commuter, notable for its sleek and elegant aesthetics which earned it a Red Dot Design Award. Powering the scooter is a TTFAR motor, often quoted with a rated power of 2000W and a peak power of 3000W, allowing for a top speed of around 60 km/h. Its range is a strong selling point, typically stated to be up to 100-150 km depending on the source and testing conditions, thanks to its high-capacity 72V 38Ah Graphene battery. The G6 also features modern touches like full LED lighting, a digital display, and smartphone connectivity for real-time status monitoring, alongside practical elements such as dual disc brakes, regenerative braking, and a generous under-seat storage capacity (around 30 liters). It is positioned as a comfortable and high-performance option in the electric scooter market, combining functionality with an eye-catching, futuristic design.
specs: F: AC28-F Aluminum Drum R: Hydraulic shock breaker

Description: The Yadea Trooper 01 is a distinct, moped-style electric bike that blends the nostalgic look of a traditional cafe racer or moto-bike with modern e-bike technology. It's powered by a 750W rear hub motor with 75 Nm of torque, offering impressive acceleration and hill-climbing capabilities. The e-bike is equipped with a large 48V 20Ah (960Wh) lithium battery, providing a considerable range, estimated up to 56 miles on pedal assist (Eco mode) and around 31-45 miles using throttle-only. Designed for comfort and all-terrain versatility, it features dual suspension (RST front fork and rear shock) and robust 20-inch by 4-inch fat knobby tires. Safety is addressed with Tektro hydraulic disc brakes and integrated lighting. The Trooper 01 includes a practical, frame-mounted cargo box and has a UL certification, appealing to riders seeking a powerful, stylish, and comfortable option for urban and light off-road adventures.

The newly unveiled 2026 Yamaha NMAX 155 Tech MAX elevates the sport scooter segment with a focus on advanced technology and a premium riding experience. A standout feature is the innovative Yamaha Electric Continuously Variable Transmission (YECVT), which allows riders to switch between 'Sport' and 'Town' modes, adjusting engine performance to offer either faster acceleration or a smoother, more relaxed ride. This transmission also includes a unique 'Downshift' function, providing stronger acceleration or increased engine braking, mimicking the feel of a geared motorcycle. The scooter is powered by a 155cc EURO5+ Blue Core engine with Variable Valve Actuation (VVA) and benefits from a Start & Stop system for fuel efficiency. Rider connectivity is boosted by a 4.2-inch connected TFT dashboard with integrated Garmin Navigation, alongside premium touches like an exclusive leather-finish seat with gold stitching. With dynamic MAX-inspired styling, dual-eye LED projector headlights, and standard ABS on its 230mm front and rear disc brakes, the NMAX 155 Tech MAX offers a sophisticated blend of performance and urban practicality.

Description: The newly launched 2026 Honda CB1000GT enters the sport-touring segment as a compelling blend of superbike performance and long-distance comfort, built upon the foundation of the CB1000 Hornet platform. At its heart is a retuned 1,000cc inline-four engine, derived from the CBR1000RR Fireblade, delivering a smooth yet potent output of nearly 148 horsepower. What sets the GT apart is its wealth of standard touring-focused technology and equipment, including Showa EERA (Electronically Equipped Ride Adjustment) semi-active suspension, a six-axis Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) for lean-sensitive rider aids like Cornering ABS, and Throttle-by-Wire control with multiple riding modes. Further enhancing its GT credentials are a high-specification package featuring standard detachable hard panniers, a quickshifter, heated grips, cruise control, and a five-position adjustable windscreen, all making it a highly attractive and aggressively priced contender for riders seeking a single motorcycle capable of both thrilling backroad blasts and effortless cross-continent travel.

Description: The newly released Kawasaki Z500 2027 brings a perfect blend of aggressive styling, modern performance, and everyday practicality to the middleweight naked bike segment. Inspired by Kawasaki’s “Sugomi” design philosophy, the Z500 flaunts a muscular and sharp appearance with LED lighting and a minimalistic tail section. Powering the bike is a refined 451cc parallel-twin engine, delivering smooth yet thrilling performance suitable for both city commutes and spirited rides. The lightweight chassis ensures agile handling, while advanced features like a TFT display with smartphone connectivity, assist and slipper clutch, and ABS add to the premium feel. Positioned as an ideal step-up model for new riders and a fun, versatile option for experienced ones, the Z500 2027 continues Kawasaki’s legacy of pure naked sport excitement.
